original: karmaṇyupapade ṭakpratyayo vidhīyate | sāmagaḥ surāpa ityudāraṇam | ṭaki kakārānubandhaḥ sāmagā a ityatra "āto lopa iṭi ca' (sū.6-4-64) ityākāralopārthaṃ kriyate | sa māstu | ākārāvayavasya akārasya "ato lopaḥ' (sū.6-4-48) iti lope kṛte sāmaga a a iti sthite dvayorakārayoḥ pararūpeṇeṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ sidhyatīti kimākāralopārthena kakārānubandhena |

original: evaṃ "bahupūgagaṇasaṅghasya tithuk' (sū.5-2-52) iti sūtreṇa bahugaṇaśabdayoḥ ḍaḍḍatdh;ṭi pare tithugāgamo vidhīyate | ḍaḍḍatdh;ṭra ca "tasya pūraṇe ḍaḍḍatdh;ṭra' (sū.5-2-48) ityanena prāpaṇiyaḥ | tathoḥ saṃkhyāśabdena agrahaṇe ḍaḍḍatdh;ṭo'prāptyā tasmin pare āgamavidhānamanupapannaṃ sat bahugaṇayoḥ saṃkhyākārthaṃ jñāpayati |

original: evaṃ "ṣaṭūkatikatipayacaturāṃ thuk' (sū.5-2-51) iti sūtreṇa ḍaḍḍatdh;tyantāt katiśabdāt saṃkhyāyāḥ vihite ḍaḍḍatdh;ti pare vidhīyamānaḥ thugāgamaḥ ḍaḍḍatdh;tyantasyāpi saṃkhyākārthaṃ bhavatīti jñāpayati | evaṃ vatuviṣaye "vatorathiuk' (sū.5-2-53) iti sūtramapi saṃkhyākāryasya jñāpakam |

original: tatprayojanaṃ ca "luṅūmukhasvaropacārāḥ' iti vārtike proktam | upāgni pratyagri ityādau avyayībhāvāt parasya supaḥ "avyayādāpsupaḥ' iti sūtreṇa lugvaktavyaḥ | sa cāvyayībhāvasyāvyayasaṃjñāṃ vinā na saṃbhavatīti luk prathamaṃ prayojanam | tacca jñāpakādeva nirvahati |
analyzed: tad prayojanam ca iti vārtike proktam upāgni pratyagri ityādau avyayībhāvāt parasya supaḥ iti sūtreṇa luk vaktavyaḥ sa ca avyayībhāvasya avyaya saṃjñām vinā na saṃbhavati iti   prathamam prayojanam tat ca jñāpakāt eva nirvahati

original: tathā hi "nāvyayībhāvādato'm tvapañcamyāḥ ' (sū.2-4-83) iti sūtreṇa adantādavyayībhāvātparasya supaḥ luk na bhavatīti yaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ saḥ "avyayādāpsupaḥ' iti sūtreṇa prāptasya luka iti vaktavyam | avyayībhāvasyāvyayatvābhāve subluko'prāptyā tanniṣedho vyarthaḥ san bhavatyavyayībhāvātparasya supo lugiti jñāpayati | tathā
analyzed: tathā hi tva pañcamyāḥ sū iti sūtreṇa a t antāt avyayībhāvāt parasya supaḥ luk na bhavati iti yaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ saḥ avyayāt āp supaḥ iti sūtreṇa prāptasya   iti vaktavyam avyayībhāvasya avyaya tva abhāve tad niṣedhaḥ vyarthaḥ san bhavati avyayībhāvāt parasya supaḥ luk iti jñāpayati tathā

original: cāvyayasaṃjñāṃ vinaiva jñāpakādevāvyayībhāvātparasya supo luksiddheḥ tatprayojanakatvamavyayībhāvasyavyayasaṃjñāyā na yujyata iti bhāṣye sthitam | tadāha--nāvyayībhāvāditi | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa na lumatā (sū.1-1-63)|| sātpratiṣedho jñāpakaḥ svādiṣu padatvena yeṣāṃ padasaṃjñā na tebhyaḥ pratiṣedha iti |
analyzed: ca avyaya saṃjñām vinā eva jñāpakāt eva avyayībhāvāt parasya supaḥ luk siddheḥ tad prayojanaka tvam avyayībhāvasya avyaya saṃjñāyāḥ na yujyate iti bhāṣye sthitam tat āha na avyayībhāvāt iti na sū1163 sāt pratiṣedhaḥ jñāpakaḥ sva ādiṣu pada tvena yeṣām pada saṃjñā na tebhyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti

original: jhrvi.ṭa ṭhana lumatāṅgasya' iti sūtre "uttarapadatve cāpadādividhā' viti vārtikam | uttarapadasya padavyapadeśe kartavye pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ na bhavati padādividhiṃ varjayitvā iti tadarthaḥ | paramavācā ityādau paramā ca sā vāk ceti vigrahe paramā sū vāc su iti sthite samāse tadavayavasuporluki samudāyādvibhaktau satyāṃ paramavācā iti bhavati |
analyzed: ṭhana lumatā aṅgasya iti sūtre uttara pada tve ca a pada ādi vidhau iti vārtikam uttara padasya pada vyapadeśe kartavye pratyaya lakṣaṇam na bhavati pada ādi vidhim varjayitvā iti tad arthaḥ parama vācā ityādau paramā ca sā vāc ca iti vigrahe paramā vāc su iti sthite samāse tad avayava supoḥ luki samudāyāt vibhaktau satyām parama vācā iti bhavati

original: tatra vāc ityasya samāsārthā yā vibhaktiḥ kṛtā tāṃ pratyayalakṣaṇenāśritya subantatvāt padasaṃjñāyāṃ "coḥ kuḥ' (sū.8-2-30) iti kutvaṃ prāpnoti | ataḥ uttarapadasya padatvavyapadeśe kartavye pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ na bhavatītivaktavyam |
analyzed: tatra vāc iti asya samāsa arthā yā vibhaktiḥ kṛtā tām pratyaya lakṣaṇena āśritya sup anta tvāt pada saṃjñāyām coḥ kuḥ sū 8230 iti ku tvam prāpnoti atas uttara padasya pada tva vyapadeśe kartavye pratyaya lakṣaṇam na bhavati iti vaktavyam

original: evaṃ cet dadhisecāvityatra dadhnaḥ secāviti vigrahe samāsāvayavasuporluki pratyayalakṣaṇena padatvamāśritya "sātpadādyoḥ' (sū.8-3-111) iti ṣatvaniṣedha iṣyate, sa na syāt ata uktam apadādividhāviti | ṣatvaniṣedhasya padādividhitvāt pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeveti na doṣa iti vārtikāśayaḥ |
analyzed: evam ced dadhi secau iti atra dadhnaḥ secau iti vigrahe samāsa avayava supoḥ luki pratyaya lakṣaṇena pada tvam āśritya sāt pada ādyoḥ sū 83111 iti ṣatva niṣedhaḥ iṣyate sa na syāt atas uktam a pada ādi vidhau iti ṣatva niṣedhasya pada ādi vidhi tvāt pratyaya lakṣaṇam bhavati eva iti na doṣaḥ iti vārtika āśayaḥ

original: bhāṣyakārastu "yaci bham' ityasya yajādipratyaye pūrvaṃ bhasaṃjñaṃ bhavatīti vyākhyānaṃ kṛtvā "paramavācā' ityādau bhatvātpadatvābhāvena kutvāprāptervārtikaṃ pratyākhyeyamityupapādayāmāsa |
analyzed: bhāṣyakāraḥ tu ya ci bham iti asya yaj ādi pratyaye pūrvam bha saṃjñam bhavati iti vyākhyānam kṛtvā param avācā ityādau bha tvāt pada tva abhāvena ku tva aprāpteḥ vārtikam pratyākhyeyam iti upapādayāmāsa

original: tadupari yadi vārtikaṃ prātyākhyāyate tarhi "apadādividhau pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedho na'ityarthasyālābhāt "dadhisesau' ityādau padāditvaprayuktaṣatvapratiṣedhaḥ kathaṃ sādhanīyaḥ ityāśaṅkāyāmāha sma bhāṣyakāraḥ "sātpadādyoḥ' iti sūtre padasyādiriti na vigrahaḥ, api tu padādādiriti |
analyzed: tad upari yadi vārtikam prātyākhyāyate tarhi apada ādi vidhau pratyaya lakṣaṇa pratiṣedhaḥ na eti arthasya alābhāt dadhi sesau ityādau pada ādi tva prayukta ṣa tva pratiṣedhaḥ katham sādhanīyaḥ iti āśaṅkāyām āha sma bhāṣyakāraḥ sāt pada ādyoḥ iti sūtre padasya ādiḥ iti na vigrahaḥ api tu padāt ādiḥ iti

original: tathā ca daghi iti padāt parasya ādeḥ sakārasya ṣatvaṃ na bhavatīti | tadupari--tarhi ṛkṣu vākṣu ityādiṣvapi ṣatvaniṣedhaḥ syāt ṛkśabdasya svādiṣviti padatvāt tataḥ parasya ādeḥ pratyayādeḥ sakārasyāpi ṣatvaniṣedhaḥ prāpnotītyāśaṅkya, svādiṣviti sūtreṇa yeṣāṃ padasaṃjñā tataḥ parasya ṣatvapratiṣegho na bhavati | ataḥ vākṣu ityādau na doṣaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca daghi iti padāt parasya ādeḥ sakārasya ṣatvam na bhavati iti tad upari tarhi ṛkṣu vākṣu ityādiṣu api ṣatva niṣedhaḥ syāt ṛk śabdasya sva ādiṣu iti pada tvāt tatas parasya ādeḥ pratyaya ādeḥ sakārasya api ṣatva niṣedhaḥ prāpnoti iti āśaṅkya sva ādiṣu iti sūtreṇa yeṣām pada saṃjñā tatas parasya ṣatva pratiṣeghaḥ na bhavati atas vākṣu ityādau na doṣaḥ

original: dadhisecāvatyitra tu antarvartinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya "suptiṅantaṃ padam ' (sū.1-4-14) iti dadhiśabdasya padasaṃjñā na "svādiṣu' iti | ataḥ tataḥ parasya sakārasya ṣatvaniṣedho bhavatyeva | uktaviṣaye jñāpakaṃ tu "sātpadādyoḥ' iti sūtre sādgrahaṇam | taddhi agnisādityādau ṣatvaniṣedhāya |
analyzed: dadhi secau ati itra tu antar vartinīm vibhaktim āśritya sup tiṅ antam padam sū1414 iti dadhi śabdasya pada saṃjñā na sva ādiṣu iti atas tatas parasya sakārasya ṣatva niṣedhaḥ bhavati eva ukta viṣaye jñāpakam tu sāt pada ādyoḥ iti sūtre sāt grahaṇam tat hi agni sāt ityādau ṣatva niṣedhāya

original: agni ityasya "svādiṣu' iti padatvāttataḥ parasya sakārasya padādāderityanenaiva ṣatvaniṣedhe labdhe sādgrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt | kṛtaṃ ca tat uktavacanaṃ jñāpayati iti samādhānamuktaṃ bhāṣye | tadeva paṭhati-- sātpratiṣedho jñāpaka iti | jhrjñā.paṭa sthānivadādeśo (sū.1-1-56)||
analyzed: agni iti asya su ādiṣu iti pada tvāt tatas parasya sakārasya padāt ādeḥ iti anena eva ṣatva niṣedhe labdhe sāt grahaṇam vyartham syāt kṛtam ca tat ukta vacanam jñāpayati iti samādhānam uktam bhāṣye tat eva paṭhati sāt pratiṣedhaḥ jñāpakaḥ iti sthāni vat ādeśaḥ sū1156

original: "yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe (sū.7-2-86) ityādeśe pratiṣedhāt jñāpakāt sthānivadādeśo bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa sthānivatsūtraṃ pratyākhyātumāha--yuṣmadasmadoriti | "yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe' iti sūtreṇa halodau vibhaktau parato yuṣmadasmadorākāraṃ vidhāya ādeśe parataḥ ātvaṃ pratiṣidhyate |
analyzed: yuṣmad asmadoḥ an ādeśe sū7286 iti ādeśe pratiṣedhāt jñāpakāt sthānivat ādeśaḥ bhavati iti jhrviṭa sthānivat sūtram pratyākhyātum āha yuṣmad asmadoḥ iti yuṣmad asmadoḥ an ādeśe iti sūtreṇa ha l udau vibhaktau paratas yuṣmad asmadoḥ ākāram vidhāya ādeśe paratas ā tvam pratiṣidhyate

original: tatra vibhaktayādeśasya vibhaktitvābhāvādeva ādeśe parata ātvāprasakteḥ kimanādeśa iti pratiṣedhena | sa kriyamāṇaḥ ādeśaḥ sthānivat iti jñāpayati | tataśca vibhattayādeśasya sthānivadbhāvena vibhaktitvamādāya tasmin parata ātve prāpte tanniṣedhāya anādeśa ityuktamiti svāṃśe cāritārthyam | tathā ca sūtraṃ pratyākhyeyamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tatra vibhattayā ādeśasya vibhakti tva abhāvāt eva ādeśe paratas ātva aprasakteḥ kim anādeśaḥ iti pratiṣedhena sa kriyamāṇaḥ ādeśaḥ sthāni vat iti jñāpayati tatas ca vibhattayā ādeśasya sthānivat bhāvena vibhakti tvam ādāya tasmin paratas ātve prāpte tad niṣedhāya anādeśaḥ iti uktam iti sva aṃśe cāritārthyam tathā ca sūtram pratyākhyeyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇam' iti sūtreṇa pratyayasya lope sati pratyayanimittakaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatītyucyamānaṃ pratyayasya luki na prāpnoti | lope hi pratyalakṣaṇamucyate na luki | tataśca pañca saptetyādau "ṣaṅūbhyo luk' (sū.7-1-22) iti jaśśasorluki pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvātpadasaṃjñā na syādityāśaṅkyāha--na lumateti |

original: tataśca paṭataiti paṭeti iti syāt | paṭati iti ceṣyate | ataḥ "nānarthake'lontyavidhiḥ' iti paribhāṣā āśrayaṇīyā | paṭat ityasya yo'yamacchabdastasyānarthakatvāttatrālo'ntyavidherapravṛttyā at ityasyaiva pararūpamitīṣṭasiddhiriti tadāśayaḥ | vastuta idaṃ prayojanaṃ na yoyujyate, jñāpakādevāntyasya pararūpaṃ na bhavatītyavagamādityāha--yadayamiti |

original: tataśca āmreḍiḍḍatdh;tasya at ityasya pararūpe prapte tannaṣidhya antyasya vikalpavidhānamiti svāṃśe cāritārthyām | evaṃ cānenaiva paṭat iti ityatrāpi antyasya pararūpābhāve siddhe "nānarthake'lontyavidhiḥ' paribhāṣāyāḥ nedaṃ prayojanamityāśayaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya (sū.1-1-68)|| rūpagrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati astyanyadrūpātsvaṃ śabdasyeti |

original: "ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ' (1-1-24) iti ṣakārāntāyāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ ṣaṭsaṃjñājñāpakāt śabdasaṃjñāyāṃ na svarūpavidhirbhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya' iti sūtre svāśabdasyātmīyavācitvena saṃbandhagrahaṇanirapekṣatayā prathamataḥ śrotreṇopasthityā ca svāśabdena ātmīyaṃ rūpameva grahīṣyata iti kiṃ rūpagrahaṇenetyata aha--rūpagrahaṇamiti |

original: tathā ca rūpagrahaṇāt rūpadanyat arthaviśiṣṭa svarūpaṃ śabdasya svīyamastīti gamyate | tathā ca rūpagrahaṇāt rūpādanyat arthaviśiṣṭa svarūpaṃ śabdasya svīyamastīti gamyate | tathā ca śabdasyārthaviśiṣṭaṃ svarūpaṃ saṃjīti bodhanārthaṃ rūpagrahaṇam | etenātra śāstre arthaviśiṣṭaṃ śabdasvarūpameva gṛhyate nānarthakamiti labhyate |

original: "ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ' iti sūtre ṣaṭ ityanena ṣaṣ iti śabdasvarūpasya grahaṇāt tasya ṣaṭsaṃjñāyāḥ vacanaprāmāṇyācca nakārantasya ṣaṭsaṃjñāyāḥ siddhe ṣakāragrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ sat śabdasaṃjñāyāṃ svarūpavidhirna bhavatīti jñāpayatīti ṭi ghu ityādau svarūpagrahaṇābhāvasiddherityāha--ṣṇāntā ṣaḍiḍḍatdh;ti | tathā ca aśabdasaṃjñetyanāvaśyakameveti bhāvaḥ |

original: seṭaḥ sanaḥ aupadeśikaṃ kittvaṃ nāsti, api tu "iko jhak' ityanena ātideśikam | tasya ca "na seṭ'ityanena pratiṣedho na bhavediti jhalgrahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti svāṃśe cāritārthyam | anyatra prayojanaṃ tu jagmivetyādau "asaṃyogālliṭ kit' (sū.1-2-5) ityātideśikasya kittvasya "na seṭ' iti pratiṣedho na bhavatīti kṅitītyupadhālopaḥ sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ |

original: jhrjñā.paṭa ūkālo'c (sū.1-2-27) || "vibhāṣā pṛṣṛprativacane heḥ' (sū.8-2-93) iti mātrakasya plutavacanaṃ jñāpakaṃ na mātriki'nte bhavatīti | "ato dīrgho yañi, supi ca' (sū.7-3-101-102) iti dīrghavidhānaṃ jñāpakaṃ na mātriko madhye bhavatīti | "omabhyādāne' (sū.8-2-87) iti dvimātrasya plutavidhānaṃ jñāpakaṃ na dvimātro'nte bhavatīti |

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "ūkālaḥ' iti sūtre ū iti ekamātradvimātratrimātrāṇāṃ praśliṣṭanirdeśaḥ | tatra ca yathāsaṃkhyāmanvayena ekamātrasya hrasvasaṃjñā dvimātrasya dīrghasaṃjñā trimātrasya plutasaṃjñā ceṣyate | tatra krameṇa saṃniviṣṭānāmekamātradvimātratrimātrāṇāmeva praśliṣṭanirdeśo'yamiti kathamavagamyate |
analyzed: nanu ū kālaḥ iti sūtre ū iti eka mātra dvi mātra tri mātrāṇām praśliṣṭa nirdeśaḥ tatra ca yathā saṃkhyām anvayena eka mātrasya hrasva saṃjñā dvi mātrasya dīrgha saṃjñā tri mātrasya pluta saṃjñā ca iṣyate tatra krameṇa saṃniviṣṭānām eka mātra dvi mātra tri mātrāṇām eva praśliṣṭa nirdeśaḥ yam iti katham avagamyate

original: mātriko madhye vā ante vā bhavatu, dvimātraḥ ādau vā ante vāstu, trimātraḥ ādau vā madhye vāstu | tataśca ekamātrasyaiva hrasvatvamityādivyavasthā na labhyetetyāśaṅkyāha--iti mātrikasya plutavacanamiti | yadi hi mātrikasyānte nirdeśaḥ syāt tadā yo'nte sa plutasaṃjña iti ekamātrasya plutasaṃjñeti vaktavyam |
analyzed: mātrikaḥ madhye vā ante vā bhavatu dvi mātraḥ ādau vā ante vā astu tri mātraḥ ādau vā madhye vā astu tatas ca eka mātrasya eva hrasva tvam ityādi vyavasthā na labhyeta iti āśaṅkya āha eti mātrikasya pluta vacanam iti yadi hi mātrikasya ante nirdeśaḥ syāt tadā yaḥ ante sa pluta saṃjñaḥ iti eka mātrasya pluta saṃjñā iti vaktavyam

original: tataśca "hi' ityatra ikārasyaikamātrasya plutatvāt "vibhāṣā pṛṣṭaprativacane heḥ' iti tasya plutavidhānamanarthakam | atastadvidhānaṃ na mātriko'nte bhavatīti jñāpayati | evaṃ yadi mātriko madhye bhavet yo madhye sa dīrghasaṃjña iti ekamātrasya dīrghatvāt "atodīrgho yañi' iti dvimātrasya dvimātrātmakaplutavidhānamanarthakam |
analyzed: tatas ca hi iti atra ikārasya eka mātrasya pluta tvāt vibhāṣā pṛṣṭa prativacane heḥ iti tasya pluta vidhānam anarthakam atas tad vidhānam na mātrikaḥ ante bhavati iti jñāpayati evam yadi mātrikaḥ madhye bhavet yaḥ madhye sa dīrgha saṃjñaḥ iti eka mātrasya dīrgha tvāt atas dīrghaḥ ya ñi iti dvi mātrasya dvi mātra ātmaka pluta vidhānam anarthakam

original: atastat na dvimātro'nte bavatīti jñāpayati | evaṃ ca mātrikasyānte madhye vā asaṃbhavena ādau niveśe dvimātrasyānte niveśāsaṃbhavena madhye niveśe ca siddhe arthāt trimātro'nte niviśta iti yathāsaṃkhyamekamātradvimātratrimātrāṇāṃ hrasvadīrghaplutasaṃjñāḥ sidyantīti bhāvaḥ | jhrjña.pā.ṭa bhūvādayo (sū.1-3-1)||
analyzed: atas tat na dvi mātraḥ ūnte bavati iti jñāpayati evam ca mātrikasya ante madhye vā asaṃbhavena ādau niveśe dvi mātrasya ante niveśa asaṃbhavena madhye niveśe ca siddhe arthāt tri mātraḥ ūnte niviśte iti yathāsaṃkhyam eka mātra dvi mātra tri mātrāṇām hrasva dīrgha pluta saṃjñāḥ sidyanti iti bhāvaḥ sū 131

original: "acisnu'(sū.6-4-77) ityatra śnugrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ na pratyayasyovaṅādeśo bhavatīti | divaḥ sāvautvavidhānaṃ jñāpayati utpadyante divśabdātsvādaya
analyzed: iti atra śnu grahaṇam jñāpakam na pratyayasya uvaṅ ādeśaḥ bhavati iti divaḥ jñāpayati utpadyante div śabdāt svādaya

original: iti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ' iti sūtreṇa ye dhātupāṭhe paṭhitā bhū ityādayasteṣāṃ dhātusaṃjñā vidhīyate | tathā sti trasnū ityatra uvaṅāvattiḥ | nu ityasya dhātupāṭhe paṭhitatvena trasnu au ityatra nu ityasya dhātutvena "aci śnudhātubhruvāṃ thvoḥ' ityuvaṅādeśasya saṃbhavāt | na ca ṇurdhatuṣu paṭhito na tu nuḥ | na cāsya tena sārūpyam |
analyzed: iti nanu bhū ādayaḥ dhātavaḥ iti sūtreṇa ye dhātu pāṭhe paṭhitāḥ bhū ityādayaḥ teṣām dhātu saṃjñā vidhīyate tathā sti trasnū ityatra uvaṅ avattiḥ nu ityasya dhātu pāṭhe paṭhita tvena trasnu au ityatra nu ityasya dhātu tvena a ci śnu dhātu bhruvām thvoḥ iti uvaṅ ādeśasya saṃbhavāt na ca ṇuḥ dhatuṣu paṭhitaḥ na tu nuḥ na ca asya tena sārūpyam

original: tathā ca kathamiyamāśaṅketi vācyam | prayoge nuśabdasyaiva dhātutvena tatsārupyasya trasnu ityatra nuśabde'pi sttvādityat āha--śnugrahaṇamiti | yadi pratyayasyāpyuvaṅādeśa syāttadā śnupratyaye na ityasyāpi dhātutvenaivovaṅaḥ siddheḥ śnugrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | kṛtaṃ ca tat pratyayātmako yo dhātusarūpaḥ tasyovaṅādeśo na bhavatīti jñāpayati |
analyzed: tathā ca katham iyam āśaṅkā iti vācyam prayoge nuśabdasya eva dhātu tvena tad sārupyasya trasnu iti atra nuśabda api sttvāt iti at āha śnugrahaṇam iti yadi syāt tadā śnu pratyaye naḥ ityasya api dhātu tvena eva uvaṅaḥ siddheḥ śnugrahaṇam anarthakam syāt kṛtam ca tat pratyaya ātmakaḥ yaḥ dhātu sarūpaḥ tasya uvaṅ ādeśaḥ na bhavati iti jñāpayati

original: tathā ca na doṣa iti bhāvaḥ | nanvevamapi avyutpanno yo divśabdastasya dhātupāṭhapaṭhitadivsarūpatvena dhātusaṃjñāyām "adhātuḥ' iti pratiṣedhāt prātipadikasaṃjñā na sidhyet | tataśca prātipadikatvaprayuktā svādyutpattirna syādityāśaṅkyāha--divaḥ sāviti |
analyzed: tathā ca na doṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu evam api avyutpannaḥ yaḥ div śabdaḥ tasya dhātu pāṭha paṭhita div sarūpa tvena dhātu saṃjñāyām a dhātuḥ iti pratiṣedhāt prātipadika saṃjñā na sidhyet tatas ca prātipadika tva prayuktā sva ādi utpattiḥ na syāt iti āśaṅkya āha divaḥ sau iti

original: "diva aut' (sū.7-1-84) iti sūtreṇa divaḥ sau pare autvaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ divaḥ prātipadikatvābhāvena soreva durlabhatvenāsaṃgataṃ sat dhātusaṃjñakādapi divśabdāt svādyutpattirmavatīti jñāpayati | ato na doṣa iti bhāvaḥ | vastutastu kriyāvācināmeva bhūvādīnāṃ dhātusaṃjñā ityetadanāśritya jñāpakadvayamidamupanyastam |
analyzed: divaḥ au t sū 7184 iti sūtreṇa divaḥ sau pare au tvam vidhīyamānam divaḥ prātipadika tva abhāvena soḥ eva durlabha tvena asaṃgatam sat dhātu saṃjñakāt api div śabdāt sva ādi utpattiḥ mavati iti jñāpayati atas na doṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ vastutas tu kriyā vācinām eva bhū ādīnām dhātu saṃjñā iti etat an āśritya jñāpaka dvayam idam upanyastam

original: jhrvi.ṭa ṭhacuṭū' iti sūtre "hara upasaṃkhyānam' iti vārtikam | rudhir ityādau ira itsaṃjñā vaktavyā | "irito vā' (sū.3-1-57) ityanena aṅ na syāt | na ca rephasya "halantyam' (sū.1-3-3) ityanena, ikārasya "upadeśe'janunāsikaḥ' (sū.1-3-2) ityanena ca itsaṃjñakatvāt na doṣa iti vācyam | tathā sati idittvaprayuktavidherapi prasaṅgāt |
analyzed: iti sūtre haraḥ upasaṃkhyānam iti vārtikam rudhiḥ ityādau i raḥ i t saṃjñā vaktavyā vā sū3157 iti anena aṅ na syāt na ca rephasya ha l antyam sū133 iti anena ikārasya upadeśe i anunāsikaḥ sū132 iti anena ca i t saṃjñaka tvāt na doṣaḥ iti vācyam tathā sati i t it tva prayukta vidheḥ api prasaṅgāt

original: iritāṃ keṣāṃciddhātūnāṃ "u undir niśāmane' "skandir gatiśoṣaṇayoḥ' ityevaṃ numanuṣaktānāṃ pāṭhāt iritāmidtkārthaṃ neti jñāpyate | ato bhettetyādau numāpattivirahāditi nyarūpayat | tadāha--undir niśāmana ityādinā | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ṇeraṇau (sū.1-3-67)|| anādhyāna iti pratiṣedho jñāpayati bhavatyevaṃjātīyakānām ātmanepadamiti |

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "ṇeraṇau yatkarma ṇau cetsa kartānādhyāne' iti sūtrasya ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ bhavati aṇau yā kriyā saiva ceṇṇyantenocyeta aṇau yatkarmakārakaṃ sa ceṇṇau kartā syādanādhyāne ityarthaḥ | tatra "anādhyāne' iti vyartham |

original: tadananuvṛttau ca tiṅantasyāpi samāso bhavediti tadvāraṇārthamatiṅgrahaṇamiti svāṃśe cāritārthayam | nanvatraiva sūtre atiṅgrahaṇāt suvo nivṛttirjñāpyatām | pūrvasūtre kathaṃ nivṛttajñirāpyeta iti cet-atrāhuḥ| "kugatiprādayaḥ' ityatra "kuprādayaḥ' "gatiḥ' iti dvedhā yogo vibhajyate |
analyzed: tad ananuvṛttau ca tiṅ antasya api samāsaḥ bhavet iti tad vāraṇa artham atiṅgrahaṇam iti sva aṃśe nanu atra eva sūtre nivṛttiḥ jñāpyatām pūrva sūtre katham iti ced atra āhuḥ ku gati pra ādayaḥ iti atra gatiḥ iti dvedhā yogaḥ vibhajyate

original: tatra prathamasūtrasya kuprādayaḥ subantena samāsyante ityarthaḥ | evam "upapadam' "atiṅ' iti ca yogo vibhajyate | atiṅ ityayaṃ "gatiḥ' "upapadam' iti dvayorapi śeṣabhūtaḥ | supā ityetat ubhayatra uktajñāpakānnivartate | atiṅ ityeṣa prathamāntaḥ yogadvayavihitasya samāsasya viśeṣaṇam |
analyzed: tatra prathama sūtrasya kupra ādayaḥ sup antena samāsyante iti arthaḥ evam upapadam atiṅ iti ca yogaḥ vibhajyate atiṅ iti ayam gatiḥ upapadam iti dvayoḥ api śeṣa bhūtaḥ supā iti etat ubhayatra ukta jñāpakāt nivartate atiṅ iti eṣa prathama antaḥ yoga dvaya vihitasya samāsasya viśeṣaṇam

original: tathā ca sūtradvayavihitaḥ samāsaḥ tiṅantaghaṭito na bhavatītyarthaḥ | tataśca sūtradvayo'pi ātiṅ ityasya saṃbandhāt tat sūtradvayo'pi supā ityasya nivṛttijñāpakamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca sūtra dvaya vihitaḥ samāsaḥ tiṅ anta ghaṭitaḥ na bhavati iti arthaḥ tatas ca sūtra dvaya upi ityasya saṃbandhāt tat sūtra dvaya upi supā ityasya nivṛtti jñāpakam iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃ ca sūtradvaye'pi supetyasya nivṛttyā gatīnāmupapadānāṃ ca subutpatteḥ prāk samāsaḥ sidhyatīti "gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdibhaḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpatteḥ' iti paribhāṣā siddhā bhavatīti jñāpanaphalaṃ bhāṣye uktam | na ca kārakāṇāṃ subutpatteḥ prāk samāsaḥ kathaṃ labhyeta iti vācyam | ekadeśānumatidvārā tatsiddheriti kecit |
analyzed: evam ca sūtra dvaye pi supā ityasya nivṛttyā gatīnām upapadānām ca sup utpatteḥ prāk samāsaḥ sidhyati iti gati kāraka upapadānām saha samāsa vacanam prāk sup utpatteḥ iti paribhāṣā siddhā bhavati iti jñāpana phalam bhāṣye uktam na ca kārakāṇām sup utpatteḥ prāk samāsaḥ katham labhyeta iti vācyam eka deśa anumati dvārā tad siddheḥ iti kecid

original: kaiyaṭastu kārakāṇāṃ "kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' (sū.2-3-32) iti samāsaḥ kriyate | tatra kṛdgrahaṇāt subutpatteḥ prāk samāsaḥ siddhaḥ | tiṅantena hi tṛtīyānātasya supetyasyānuvṛttyaiva samāsāprasaṅgāt kṛdantenaiva samāse siddhe kṛdgrahaṇaṃ kṛdantāvasthāyāmevānutpanne supi samāsārtham ityāha | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa anekamanyapadārthe (sū.2-2-24)||
analyzed: kaiyaṭaḥ tu kārakāṇām kartṛ karaṇe kṛtā bahulam sū2332 iti samāsaḥ kriyate tatra kṛt grahaṇāt sup utpatteḥ prāk samāsaḥ siddhaḥ tiṅ antena hi tṛtīyā nātasya supā ityasya anuvṛttyā eva samāsa aprasaṅgāt kṛt antena eva samāse siddhe kṛt grahaṇam kṛt anta avasthāyām eva anutpanne supi samāsa artham iti āha anekam anya padārthe sū2332 iti

original: uttarapadedviguvidhānaṃ jñāpayati bahūnāmapi samāso bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "anekamanyapadārthe' iti sūtre "sup supā' ityanuvṛtteḥ anyapadārthe vartamānaṃ subantaṃ subantena samasyata ityarthalābhena arthāt anekasubantasamāso
analyzed: uttara pade dvigu vidhānam jñāpayati bahūnām api samāsaḥ bhavati iti nanu anekam anya padārthe iti sūtre sup supā iti anuvṛtteḥ anya padārthe vartamānam sup antam supā samasyate iti artha lābhena arthāt aneka sup anta samāsaḥ

original: labhyata ityanekagrahaṇaṃ vyartham | na ca bahūnāṃ samāsalābhāyānekagrahaṇamiti vācyam | jñāpakādeva bahūnāṃ samāsalābhāt | jñāpakamevāha--uttarapada iti | "taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca' (sū.2-1-51) iti sūtreṇa uttarapade parataḥ saṃkhyāvācakaśabdasya samānādhikaraṇena subantena samāso vidhīyate |
analyzed: labhyate iti aneka grahaṇam vyartham na ca bahūnām samāsa lābhāya aneka grahaṇam iti vācyam jñāpakāt eva bahūnām samāsa lābhāt jñāpakam eva āha uttara pade iti taddhita artha uttara pada samāhāre ca sū2151 iti sūtreṇa uttara pade paratas saṃkhyā vācaka śabdasya samāna adhikaraṇena sup antena samāsaḥ vidhīyate

original: pañca gāvo dhanaṃ yasyeti vigrahe trayāṇāṃ padānāṃ bahuvrīhisamāse dhanaśabde paretadavayavayoḥ pañcagośabdayordvigusamāso bhavati | tatrādau trayāṇāṃ sabhāsābhāve dhanaśabdasyottarapadatvaṃ na syāt | uttarapadaśabdasya samāsacaramāvayave rūḍhatvāt |
analyzed: pañca gāvaḥ dhanam yasya iti vigrahe trayāṇām padānām bahuvrīhi samāse dhana śabde parā itad avayavayoḥ pañca go śabdayoḥ dvigu samāsaḥ bhavati tatra ādau trayāṇām dhana śabdasya uttara pada tvam na syāt uttara pada śabdasya samāsa carama avayave rūḍha tvāt

original: tathā ca uttarapade parato dvigusamāsavidhānamahimnā bahūnāmapi subantānāṃ samāso bhavatīti jñāpyate | evaṃ ca bahūnāṃ samāsalābhārthamanekapadamityetanna yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | dviguvidhānamiti | idamupalakṣaṇam | taddhitārthasūtreṇa digvācakaśabdasya subantena saha uttarapade parataḥ samāsavidhānamapyuktārethe jñāpakamiti bodhyam |
analyzed: tathā ca uttara pade paratas dvigu samāsa vidhāna mahimnā bahūnām api sup antānām samāsaḥ bhavati iti jñāpyate evam ca bahūnām samāsa lābha artham aneka padam iti etat na yuktam iti bhāvaḥ dvigu vidhānam iti idam upalakṣaṇam taddhita artha sūtreṇa diś vācaka śabdasya sup antena saha uttara pade paratas samāsa vidhānam api ukta ārethe jñāpakam iti bodhyam

original: jhrjñā.paṭa cārthe dvandvaḥ (sū.2-2-29)|| arthagrahaṇāt cena kṛto'rthaścārtha iti vijñāyate | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "cārthe dvandvaḥ' iti sūtreṇa cārthā yatra pratīyate tatra dvandvaḥ ityavagamyate | tathā ca--- "aharaharnayamāno gamaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ paśum |
analyzed: ca arthe dvandvaḥ sū2229 artha grahaṇāt cena kṛta ūrthaḥ ca arthaḥ iti vijñāyate nanu ca arthe dvandvaḥ iti sūtreṇa ca arthāḥ yatra pratīyate tatra dvandvaḥ iti avagamyate tathā ca ahar ahar nayamānaḥ gam aśvam puruṣam paśum

original: vaivasvato na tṛpyati surāyā iva durmadī||' ityatra gavādīnāṃ parasparasāhityena nayanakriyāyāmanvayāt "gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ paśum' iti vākye'pi parasparasāhityātmaketaretarayogarūpayārthe padānāṃ vṛtterdvandvasaṃjñā syāt ityaśaṅkyāha--arthagrahaṇāditi | ce dvandva ityetāvataiva caśabde kāryāsaṃbhavāt arthe kārthaṃbhavatīti vijñāsyate |
analyzed: vaivasvataḥ na tṛpyati surāyāḥ iva durmadī iti atra gavā ādīnām paraspara sāhityena nayana kriyāyām anvayāt gām aśvam puruṣam paśum iti vākye api paraspara sāhitya ātmaka itaretara yoga rūpayā arthe padānām vṛtteḥ dvandva saṃjñā syāt iti aśaṅkya āha artha grahaṇāt iti ce dvandve iti etāvatā eva caśabde kārya asaṃbhavāt arthe vijñāsyate

original: so'yamevaṃ siddhe sati yat arthagrahaṇaṃ karoti tajjñāpayati cena kṛto yo'rthastatra dvandvo bhavatīti | arthagrahaṇādavadhāraṇamāśrīyate | cenaiva kṛtaḥ prakāśito yo'rthastatra dvandva iti | gāmaśvamityatra tu aharahaḥśabdenaiva sāhityamavagamyate na tu ceneti na dvandva iti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.paṭa niṣṭhā (sū.2-2-36)||
analyzed: saḥ uyam evam siddhe sati yat artha grahaṇam karoti tat jñāpayati cena kṛtaḥ yaḥ ṛthaḥ tatra dvandvaḥ bhavati iti artha grahaṇāt avadhāraṇam āśrīyate cena eva kṛtaḥ prakāśitaḥ yaḥ ṛthaḥ tatra dvandve iti gām aśvam iti atra tu ahar ahar śabdena eva sāhityam avagamyate na tu cena iti na dvandve iti bhāvaḥ niṣṭhā sū2236

original: jātikālalukhādibhyaḥ parasyāḥ niṣṭhāyā antodāttatvavidhānāt jñāpakāt parātra niṣṭhā bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "niṣṭhā' iti sūtreṇa niṣṭhāntasya bahuvrīhau pūrvanipāto'nuśiṣyate | kṛtakṛtya ityādikamudāharaṇam | tatra sāraṅgajagdhī māsajātā sukhajātā duḥ khajātā ityādau bahuvrīhau niṣṭhantasya paranipāto'sādhuḥ syāt ityata āha--jātikāleti |
analyzed: jāti kāla lukha ādibhyaḥ parasyāḥ niṣṭhāyāḥ anta udātta tva vidhānāt jñāpakāt parā atra niṣṭhā bhavati iti jhrviṭa nanu niṣṭhā iti sūtreṇa niṣṭhā antasya bahuvrīhau pūrva nipātaḥ anuśiṣyate kṛtakṛtyaḥ iti ādikam udāharaṇam tatra sāraṅga jagdhī māsa jātā sukha jātā duḥ kha jātā ityādau bahuvrīhau niṣṭha antasya para nipātaḥ usādhuḥ syāt iti atas āha jāti kāla iti

original: "jātikālasukhādibhyo'nācchādanāt ktaḥ' (sū.6-2-170) iti sūtreṇa jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ parasya ktāntasyāntodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate bahuvrīhau | yadi jātyādibhyaḥ pūrvaṃ "niṣṭhā' ityanena ktāntasya nipātaḥ syāt tadā jātyādibhyaḥ paraṃ ktāntaṃ durlabhamiti paraṃ ktāntamanūdya svaravidhānamanupapannaṃsyāt |
analyzed: jāti kāla sukha ādibhyaḥ na ācchādanāt ktaḥ sū62170 iti sūtreṇa jāti kāla sukha ādibhyaḥ parasya kta antasya anta udātta tvam vidhīyate bahuvrīhau yadi jāti ādibhyaḥ pūrvam niṣṭhā iti anena kta antasya nipātaḥ syāt tadā jāti ādibhyaḥ param kta antam durlabham iti param kta antam anūdya svara vidhānam anupapannam syāt

original: ato'numīyate yat bahuvrīhau nātikālasukhādibhyaḥ parameva niṣṭhāntasya prayoga iti | tena sāraṅgajagghī ityādeḥ sādhutvaṃ sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.pā.ṭa caturthī saṃpradāne (sū.2-3-13)|| "caturthī tadarthārtha-' (sū.2-1-36) iti caturthyantasya arthaśabdena samāsavidhānaṃ jñāpayati bhavatyarthaśabdayogo caturthīti |
analyzed: atas anumīyate yat bahuvrīhau na ati kāla sukha ādibhyaḥ param eva niṣṭhā antasya prayogaḥ iti tena sāraṅga jagghī ityādeḥ sādhu tvam sidhyati iti bhāvaḥ caturthī saṃpradāne sū2313 caturthī tad artha artha sū2136 iti caturthī antasya artha śabdena samāsa vidhānam jñāpayati caturthī iti

original: tatraiva caturthyāntasya tadarthena samāsavidhānāt jñāpakāt bhavati tārdathye caturthīti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhacaturthī saṃpradāne' iti sūtre "tārdathya upasaṃkhyānam' vārtikam | tatra tārdathyaśabdasya tasmai arthastadarthaḥ tadarthasya bhāvaḥ tārdathyamiti niṣpattirmavati |
analyzed: tatra eva caturthyā antasya tad arthena samāsa vidhānāt jñāpakāt bhavati tārdathye caturthī iti saṃpradāne iti sūtre tārdathye upasaṃkhyānam vārtikam tatra tārdathya śabdasya tasmai arthaḥ tad arthaḥ tad arthasya bhāvaḥ tārdathyam iti niṣpattiḥ mavati

original: tatra tasmai iti caturthyantasyārthaśabdena samāso na saṃbhavati, arthaśabdena yoge caturthyā durlabhatvat, tādṛśānuśāsanābhāvādityāśaṅkya "caturthītadarthārtha' iti sūtreṇa caturthyāntasyārthaśabdena sākaṃ samāsavidhānam arthaśabdayoge caturthyā asādhutve asaṃgataṃ sat tadyoge caturthīvibhaktiṃ jñāpayatītyāha---caturthī tadarthārtheti |
analyzed: tatra tasmai iti caturthī antasya artha śabdena samāsaḥ na saṃbhavati artha śabdena yoge caturthyāḥ durlabha tvat tādṛśa anuśāsana abhāvāt iti āśaṅkya caturthī tad artha arthaḥ iti sūtreṇa caturthyā antasya artha śabdena sākam samāsa vidhānam artha śabda yoge caturthyāḥ asādhu tve asaṃgatam sat tad yoge caturthī vibhaktim jñāpayati iti āha caturthī tad artha artha iti

original: tatraiva bhāṣye "tārdathya upasaṃkhyānam' iti vārtikapratyākhyānāya jñāpakāttārdathye caturthī sādhitā | jñāpakaṃ ca "caturthī tadarthārtha' iti sūtreṇa
analyzed: tatra eva bhāṣye tārdathye upasaṃkhyānam iti vārtika pratyākhyānāya jñāpakāt tārdathye caturthī sādhitā jñāpakam ca caturthī tad artha arthaḥ iti sūtreṇa

original: caturthyantasya tadarthavācinā subantena samāsavidhānam | yadi tādarrathye caturthī na syāt tadā tadarthena sahitasya caturthyantasya daurlabhyāt caturthyāstadarthena samāsavadhiānamasaṃgataṃ syāditi | tadetadāha--tatraiva caturthyantasyeti | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa prātipadikārthaliṅga-(sū.2-3-46)||
analyzed: caturthī antasya tad artha vācinā sup antena samāsa vidhānam yadi tādarrathye caturthī na syāt tadā tad arthena sahitasya caturthī antasya daurlabhyāt caturthyāḥ tad arthena samāsa vadhi ānam asaṃgatam syāt iti tat etat āha tatra eva caturthī antasya iti prātipadika artha liṅga sū 2346

original: "saṃbodhane āmantritam' ityekayogamakṛtvā "saṃbodhane ca' "sāmantritam' (sū.2-3-47-48) iti yogavibhāgakaraṇaṃ jñāpayati na karmādiviśiṣṭe prathamā bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu vibhaktiviṣaye pratyayaniyamo'rthaniyamaśceti pakṣadvayam | tatra karmaṇyeva dvitīyetyevamādirupaḥ pratyayaniyamaḥ | karmaṇi dvitīyaivetyevamādirūpo'rthaniyamaḥ |
analyzed: saṃbodhane āmantritam iti eka yogam a kṛtvā saṃbodhane ca sāmantritam sū234748 iti yoga vibhāga karaṇam jñāpayati na karma ādi viśiṣṭe prathamā bhavati iti nanu vibhakti viṣaye pratyaya niyama ūrtha niyamaḥ ca iti pakṣa dvayam tatra karmaṇi eva dvitīyā iti evamādi rupaḥ pratyaya niyamaḥ karmaṇi dvitīyā eva iti evamādi rūpa ūrtha niyamaḥ

original: tatra pratyayaniyamapakṣe "prātipadikārtha' sūtre (sū.2-3-46) mātrapadābhāve karmādiṣvapi prathamā syāt | karmaṇyeva dvitīyeti niyamena hi dvitīyāyāḥ karmātiriktārthavyāvartane'pi karmaṇi dvitīyātiriktā vibhaktirna vyārvatyate |
analyzed: tatra pratyaya niyama pakṣe prātipadika artha sūtre mātra pada abhāve karma ādiṣu api prathamā syāt karmaṇi eva dvitīyā iti niyamena hi dvitīyāyāḥ karma atirikta artha vyāvartane api karmaṇi dvitīyā atiriktā vibhaktiḥ na

original: tathā ca karmādiṣvapi prathamāyāḥ vyavacchedārthaṃ mātrapadamiti prayojanamuktvā jñāpakena karmādiṣu prathamāṃ niṣidhya mātrapadasyoktavidhaṃ prayojanaṃ nirākṛtaṃ bhāṣye | tadāha--saṃbodhana ityādinā |
analyzed: tathā ca karma ādiṣu api prathamāyāḥ vyavaccheda artham mātra padam iti prayojanam uktvā jñāpakena karma ādiṣu prathamām niṣidhya mātra padasya uktavidham prayojanam nirākṛtam bhāṣye tat āha saṃbodhane ityādinā

original: ayamāśayaḥ--yadi prāpipadikārthādadhikārthe'pi prathamā syāttadā saṃbodhanādhikye'pi prātipadikārthasūtreṇaiva prathamāyāḥ siddheḥ "saṃbodhane ca' iti sūtraṃ vyartham | na ca tatsūtraṃ na saṃbodhane prathamāvidhāyakam, kiṃ tu āmantritasaṃjñāyā vidhānārthamanuvādakam |
analyzed: ayam āśayaḥ yadi prāpipadika arthāt adhika arthe pi prathamā syāt tadā saṃbodhana ādhikye pi prātipadika artha sūtreṇa eva prathamāyāḥ siddheḥ saṃbodhane ca iti sūtram vyartham na ca tat sūtram na saṃbodhane prathamā vidhāyakam kim tu āmantrita saṃjñāyāḥ vidhāna artham anuvādakam

original: saṃbodhane yā prathamā sāmantritasaṃjñā syādityuttarasūtreṇa sahaikavākyatayā vākyārtha iti vācyam | tathā sati"saṃbodhane āmantritam' ityekasūtrameva brūyāt | yogavibhāgakaraṇāttu prathamasutreṇa saṃbodhanārthe prathamāyā vidhānam, dvitīyena tasyā āmantritasaṃjñāvidhānamityāśrayaṇīyam |
analyzed: saṃbodhane yā prathamā sā āmantrita saṃjñā syāt iti uttara sūtreṇa saha eka vākyatayā vākya arthaḥ iti vācyam tathā sati saṃbodhane āmantritam iti eka sūtram eva brūyāt yoga vibhāga karaṇāt tu prathama sutreṇa saṃbodhana arthe prathamāyāḥ vidhānam dvitīyena tasyāḥ āmantrita saṃjñā vidhānam iti āśrayaṇīyam

original: tatroktarītyā siddhau sūtraṃ vyarthaṃ sat na karmādhikye prathamā bhavatīti jñāpayatīti vaktavyam | tathā ca mātrapadasya karmādiṣu prathamārthatvavyavacchedaḥ na prayojanamiti | arthaniyamapakṣe tu sutarāmuktaprayojanaṃ na saṃgacchata ityanyadetat | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa baḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|vaca iñaḥ prācyabharateṣu (sū.2-4-66)||
analyzed: tatra ukta rītyā siddhau sūtram vyartham sat na karma ādhikye prathamā bhavati iti jñāpayati iti vaktavyam tathā ca mātra padasya karma ādiṣu prathama artha tva vyavacchedaḥ na prayojanam iti artha niyama pakṣe tu sutarām ukta prayojanam na saṃgacchate iti anyat etat jhrjñāpaṭa iñaḥ prācya bharateṣu sū 2466

original: "na duhasnunamāṃ yakciṇau' iti sūtreṇa duhasnunamāṃ karmakartṛlakāre pare yakciṇau pratiṣidhyete | sa cāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ dhātoḥ karmakartari yagabhāve prāptyabhāvādasaṃgataḥ san karmakartari yagbhavatītyatra jñāpaka iti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa kṛdatiṅ (sū.3-1-93)||
analyzed: na duha snu namām yak ciṇau iti sūtreṇa duha snu namām karma kartṛ lakāre pare yak ciṇau pratiṣidhyete sa ca ayam pratiṣedhaḥ dhātoḥ karma kartari yak abhāve prāpti abhāvāt asaṃgataḥ san karma kartari yak bhavati iti atra jñāpakaḥ iti bhāvaḥ kṛt a tiṅ sū 3193

original: kvacittaddhitavidhau "tiṅaśca' (sū.5-3-56) iti tiṅgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ na tiṅantādaṇādayo bhavantīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu kṛdatiṅ iti sūtre atiṅgrahaṇaṃ māstu | na ca tadabhāve tiṅo'pi kṛtsaṃjñā syāt, tataśca kṛdantatvāt paṭhatītyādeḥ pratipādikasaṃjñā syāditi vācyam | prātipadikasaṃjñāyāmapi doṣābhāvāt |
analyzed: kvacid taddhita vidhau tiṅaḥ ca sū5356 iti tiṅ grahaṇam jñāpakam na tiṅ antāt aṇ ādayaḥ bhavanti iti nanu kṛt a tiṅ iti sūtre a tiṅ grahaṇam mā astu na ca tad abhāve tiṅaḥ upi kṛt saṃjñā syāt tatas ca kṛt anta tvāt paṭhati ityādeḥ pratipādika saṃjñā syāt iti vācyam prātipadika saṃjñāyām api doṣa abhāvāt

original: ekatvādīnām tiṅoktatvāt subādīnām, tiṅantasya strītvena yogābhāvādeva ṭābādīnāṃ cāpādayitumaśakyatvāt | ca cāṇādayastaddhitāstiṅantebhyo bhaveyuriti vācyam | apatyādyarthe taddhitavidhānena tiṅantasyāpatyādibhiryogābhāvādeva
analyzed: eka tva ādīnām tiṅā ukta tvāt sup ādīnām tiṅ antasya strī tvena yoga abhāvāt eva ṭāp ādīnām ca āpādayitum aśakya tvāt ca cāṇ ādayaḥ taddhitāḥ tiṅ antebhyaḥ bhaveyuḥ iti vācyam apati ādi arthe taddhita vidhānena tiṅ antasya apati ādibhiḥ yoga abhāvāt eva

original: tatastaddhitotpatterāpādayitumaśakyatvāt | yadvā jñāpakādeva tiṅantādaṇādyutpattervārayituṃ śakyatvāt | jñāpakamevāha--kvacittaddhitavidhāviti | yadi tiṅantasyāpi prātipadikatvāt tatastaddhitotpattiḥ syāt tadā taddhitaprakaraṇe "tiṅaśca'(sū.5-3-56) iti sūtramanarthakaṃ bhavet | "atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau' (sū.5-3-55) iti sūtreṇaiva siddheḥ |
analyzed: tatas taddhita utpatteḥ āpādayitum aśakya tvāt yat vā jñāpakāt eva tiṅ antāt aṇ ādi utpatteḥ vārayitum śakya tvāt jñāpakam eva āha kvacid taddhita vidhau iti yadi tiṅ antasya api prātipadika tvāt tatas taddhita utpattiḥ syāt tadā taddhita prakaraṇe tiṅaḥ ca sū5356 iti sūtram anarthakam bhavet atiśāyane sū5355 iti sūtreṇa eva siddheḥ

original: tataśca tiṅaḥ kṛtsaṃjñāyāṃ taṅintasya pratipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ ca doṣābhāvāt "kṛdatiṅ' iti sūtre atiṅgrahaṇaṃ pratyākhyeyamityāśayaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa kṛtyāḥ (sū.3-1-95)|| arhe kṛtyatṛcgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ prāṅ ṇvuluḥ kṛtyasaṃjñā bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu kṛtyāḥ iti sūtre prāṅṇvula iti vaktavyam |
analyzed: tatas ca tiṅaḥ kṛt saṃjñāyām taṅ intasya pratipadika saṃjñāyām ca doṣa abhāvāt kṛt atiṅ iti sūtre a tiṅ grahaṇam pratyākhyeyam iti āśayaḥ kṛtyāḥ sū3195 arhe kṛtya tṛc grahaṇam jñāpakam prāṅ kṛtya saṃjñā bhavati iti nanu kṛtyāḥ iti sūtre prāk ṇvulaḥ iti vaktavyam

original: anyathā ṇvulo'pi kṛtyasaṃjñāprasaṅgādityāśaṅkyāha--arhe kṛtyeti | yadi hi "ṇvultṛcau' iti sūtrātprāgeva kṛtyasaṃjñā ityetanna syāttadā tṛco'pi kṛtyasaṃjñakatvena "arhekṛtyāḥ' ityeva sūtrayituṃ śakyam | tṛjgrahaṇaṃ cānarthakam | yataḥ "arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca' (sū.3-3-169) iti sūtre pṛthak tṛcagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tenānumīyate ṇvulaḥ prāk kṛtyasaṃjñeti |
analyzed: anyathā ṇvulaḥ upi kṛtya saṃjñā prasaṅgāt iti āśaṅkya āha arhe kṛtyā iti yadi hi ṇvul tṛcau iti sūtrāt prāk eva kṛtya saṃjñā iti etat na syāt tadā kṛtya saṃjñaka tvena arhekṛtyāḥ iti eva sūtrayitum śakyam tṛc grahaṇam ca anarthakam yatas arhe kṛtya tṛcaḥ ca sū 33169 iti sūtre pṛthak tṛca grahaṇam kṛtam tena anumīyate ṇvulaḥ prāk kṛtya saṃjñā iti

original: na coktajñāpakena tṛcaḥ prāk kṛtyasaṃjñetyarthalābhe'pi ṇvulaḥ prāgiti na labhyata iti vācyam | jñāpakasya sūtrāpekṣatvena tṛcghaṭitāt "ṇvultṛcau' iti sūtrāt prāk kṛtyasaṃjñādhikāra ityevaṃ jñāpanāt | tathā ca jñāpakena siddheḥ "prāṅṇvulaḥ' iti na vaktavyamiti bhāvaḥ | kāśikāyāṃ "kṛtyāḥ prāṅṇvulaḥ' iti yaḥ sūtrapāṭhaḥ so'nādaraṇīya iti siddham |
analyzed: na ca ukta jñāpakena tṛcaḥ prāk kṛtya saṃjñā iti artha lābhe pi ṇvulaḥ prāk iti na labhyate iti vācyam jñāpakasya sūtra apekṣa tvena tṛc ghaṭitāt ṇvul tṛcau iti sūtrāt prāk kṛtya saṃjñā adhikāraḥ iti evam jñāpanāt tathā ca jñāpakena siddheḥ prāk ṇvulaḥ iti na vaktavyam iti bhāvaḥ kāśikāyām kṛtyāḥ prāk ṇvulaḥ iti yaḥ sūtra pāṭhaḥ saḥ na ādaraṇīyaḥ iti siddham

original: jhrjñā.pa.ṭa spṛhigṛhi--(sū.3-2-158)|| luśā siddhe ālujvidhānaṃ jñāpakam anyebhyo'pyayaṃ bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "spṛhigṛhipatidayinidrātandrāśraddhābhya āluc' iti sūtre āluc iti guruḥ pratyayo na vidhīyatām | luś iti pratyaya evavidhīyatām |
analyzed: spṛhi gṛhi sū siddhe āluc vidhānam jñāpakam anyebhyaḥ api ayam bhavati iti nanu spṛhi gṛhi pati dayi nidrā tandrā śraddhābhyaḥ āluc iti sūtre āluc iti guruḥ pratyayaḥ na vidhīyatām iti pratyayaḥ iti

original: śapi kṛte spṛhayaalu iti sthite "ato dīrgho yañi' (sū.7-3-101) iti dīrgheṇa spṛhayāluḥ ityādirūpasiddherityāśaṅkyāha--luśeti | tathā ca ālucaḥ vidhānaṃ sūtrānirdiṣṭebhyo'pi dhātubhyaḥ āluc bhavatīti jñāpayati | tathā ca śayaluḥ ityādikaṃ sidhyati |
analyzed: śapi kṛte iti sthite atas dīrghaḥ ya ñi sū73101 iti dīrgheṇa spṛhayāluḥ ityādi rūpa siddheḥ iti āśaṅkya a haluśā iti tathā ca ālucaḥ vidhānam sūtra anirdiṣṭebhyaḥ api dhātubhyaḥ āluc bhavati iti jñāpayati tathā ca śayaluḥ iti ādikam sidhyati

original: tatra hi śapaḥ "adiprabhṛtibhyaḥ' (sū.2-4-72) iti luki ato dīrghasyāsaṃbhavāt luśā nirvāho na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa anadyatane luṭ (sū.3-3-15) || anadyatane lṛṭaṛ satsaṃjñāvacanaṃ jñāpayati bhavatyanadyatane lṛḍiḍḍatdh;ti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhalṛṭaḥ sadvā'(sū.3-3-14) "anadyatane luṭ' iti sūtrakramaḥ |
analyzed: tatra hi śapaḥ a di prabhṛtibhyaḥ sū2472 iti luki atas dīrghasya asaṃbhavāt nirvāhaḥ na bhavati iti bhāvaḥ anadyatane luṭ sū3315 anadyatane lṛṭ aṛ sat saṃjñā vacanam jñāpayati bhavati anadyatane lṛṭ iṭ ḍatdhti anadyatane luṭ iti sūtra kramaḥ

original: tatra "anadyatane' "luṭ' iti yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ | "anadyatane' iti sūtre "lṛṭaḥ sat' ityanuvartate | anadyatane lṛṭaḥ satsaṃjñakau śatṛśānacau ādeśau bhavata iti tadarthaḥ | "tena śvo'gnīnādāsyamānena' "śvaḥ somena yakṣyamāṇena' ityādikaṃ sidhyati | na cānadyatane lṛḍiḍḍatdh;vadhāyakanuśāsanābhāvena kathametaditi vācyam |
analyzed: tatra anadyatane luṭ iti yoga vibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ anadyatane iti sūtre lṛṭaḥ sat iti anuvartate anadyatane lṛṭaḥ sat saṃjñakau śatṛ śānacau ādeśau bhavataḥ iti tad arthaḥ tena śvas agnīn ādāsyamānena śvas somena yakṣyamāṇena iti ādikam sidhyati na ca anadyatane katham etat iti vācyam

original: yogavibhāgena anadyatane lṛṭaḥ satsaṃjñakādeśavidhānenaiva anadyatane lṛḍaḍḍatdh;stīti jñāpanāditi bhāṣye pratipāditam | tadāha--anadyatane lṛṭa iti jhrjñā.pa.ṭa āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca (sū.3-3-132)|| "saṃbhāvane'lamiti cet' (sū.3-3-154) iti jñāpakāt saṃbhāvane'pi nālarmathyaṃ gamyate |
analyzed: yoga vibhāgena anadyatane lṛṭaḥ sat saṃjñaka ādeśa vidhānena eva anadyatane lṛṭ ḍat hsti iti jñāpanāt iti bhāṣye pratipāditam tat āha anadyatane lṛṭaḥ iti jhrjñāpaṭaḥ āśaṃsāyām bhūta vat ca sū33132 saṃbhāvanā ilam iti ced sū33154 iti jñāpakāt saṃbhāvane pi na alarmathyam gamyate

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanvāsaṃsāsaṃbhāvanayoraviśeṣāt āśaṃsāyāṃ ye vidhīyante te saṃbhāvane'pi prāpnuvanti | ye ca saṃbhāvane vidhīyante te āśaṃsāyāmapi prāpnuvanti | na ca saṃbhāvane'lamartho niyamena gamyate, āśaṃsāyāṃ tu alamartho na gamyate | tathā ca tayorarthāviśeṣe'pyālarmathyākṛtabhedo'sti | tamādāya vyavasthā bhaviṣyatīti noktadoṣa iti vācyam |
analyzed: nanu āsaṃsā asaṃbhāvanayoḥ aviśeṣāt āśaṃsāyām ye vidhīyante te saṃbhāvane api prāpnuvanti ye ca saṃbhāvane vidhīyante te āśaṃsāyām api prāpnuvanti na ca saṃbhāvanā ilam arthaḥ niyamena gamyate āśaṃsāyām tu alam arthaḥ na gamyate tathā ca tayoḥ artha aviśeṣe pi ālarmathyā kṛta bhedaḥ asti tam ādāya vyavasthā bhaviṣyati iti na ukta doṣaḥ iti vācyam

original: tathā sati "saṃbhāvane'lamiti cet' (sū.3-3-154) iti sūtre alamiti cet iti viśeṣaṇavairyathyāt | yadi hi saṃbhāvane niyamenālamartho gamyeta tadā vyabhicārābhāvāt alamiti viśeṣaṇaṃ nepādīyeta | saṃbhavavyabhicārābhyāṃ hi syādviśeṣaṇamarthavat | tathā
analyzed: tathā sati saṃbhāvanā ilam iti ced sū33154 iti sūtre alam iti ced iti viśeṣaṇa vairyathyāt yadi hi saṃbhāvane niyamena alam arthaḥ gamyeta tadā vyabhicāra abhāvāt alam iti viśeṣaṇam saṃbhava vyabhicārābhyām hi syāt viśeṣaṇam arthavat tathā

original: ca saṃbhāvanāśaṃsayorālarmathyatadabhāvakṛto viśeṣo na vaktuṃ śakya iti sthitam | tadāha saṃbhāvana iti | tarhi tayorviśeṣābhāve pūrvoktāvyavasthāyāḥ kaḥ parihāra iti cet idaṃ me bhūyādityākārakecchāviśeṣaḥ āśaṃsā| ekatarakoṭikāniścitajñānaviśeṣaḥ saṃbhāvanamiti tayorbhedāt vyavasthā saṃgacchata iti kaiyaṭaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa tumarthe se-(sū.3-4-9)||
analyzed: ca saṃbhāvanā āśaṃsayoḥ ālarmathya tad abhāva kṛtaḥ viśeṣaḥ na vaktum śakyaḥ iti sthitam tat āha saṃbhāvane iti tarhi tayoḥ viśeṣa abhāve pūrvokta avyavasthāyāḥ kaḥ parihāraḥ iti ced idam me bhūyāt iti ākāraka icchā viśeṣaḥ āśaṃsā ekatara koṭika aniścita jñāna viśeṣaḥ saṃbhāvanam iti tayoḥ bhedāt vyavasthā saṃgacchate iti kaiyaṭaḥ tumun arthe tumun arthe

original: tumarthagrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati astyanyaḥ kartustumuno'rtha iti | jhrvidṛṭa ṭhatumarthe sesenase-' ityādinā sūtreṇa tumuno'rthe se sen ityādayaḥ pratyayā vaidikaprakaraṇe vidhīyante | tatra tumuno'rthaḥ kaḥ ? iti saṃdeho jāyate | na tāvat kartā tumuno'rthaḥ | tathā sati kartari se sen ityādayo bhavantīti sūtrārthaḥ syāt |
analyzed: tumunā artha grahaṇam jñāpayati asti anyaḥ kartuḥ tumunā ūrthaḥ iti ṭha tum arthe ityādinā sūtreṇa tumunā ūrthe se sen ityādayaḥ pratyayāḥ vaidika prakaraṇe vidhīyante tatra tumunā ūrthaḥ kaḥ iti saṃdehaḥ jāyate na tāvat kartā tumunā ūrthaḥ tathā sati kartari se sen ityādayaḥ bhavanti iti sūtra arthaḥ syāt

original: tadā tumartha iti padaṃ vyartham | "kartari kṛt' ityanenaiva teṣāṃ kartrarthakatvāvagamasaṃbhavāt | ata āha--tumarthagrahaṇamiti | tathā ca pūrvoktarītyā tumarthagrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ sat karturanyo'pi tumuno'rtho'stīti jñāpayati | sa ca bhāvaḥ bhāve ca sesenādaya iṣyante | tadarthaṃ tumarthagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tadā tumunārthaḥ iti padam vyartham kartari kṛt iti anena eva teṣām kartṛ arthaka tva avagama saṃbhavāt atas āha tumartha grahaṇam iti tathā ca pūrva ukta rītyā tumartha grahaṇam vyartham sat kartuḥ anyaḥ api tumunā ūrthaḥ asti iti jñāpayati sa ca bhāvaḥ bhāve ca iṣyante tad artham tumartha grahaṇam kṛtam iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃ jñāpane prayojanaṃ tu "avyayakṛto bhāve' ityetadvārtikaṃ na vaktavyaṃ bhavati | tumarthagrahaṇānuvṛttyaivaavyayakṛtāṃ ktvādīnāṃ bhāvārthakatvasiddheriti bhāṣye spaṣṭam | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa kartari kṛt (sū.3-4-67)|| "tayoreva' (sū.3-4-70) ityevakāro jñāpayati ita uttaraṃ samāveśo bhavatīti |
analyzed: evam jñāpane prayojanam tu avyaya kṛtaḥ bhāve iti etat vārtikam na vaktavyam bhavati tumartha grahaṇa anuvṛttyā eva avyaya kṛtām ktvā ādīnām bhāva arthaka tva siddheḥ iti bhāṣye spaṣṭam kartari kṛt sū3467 tayoḥ eva sū3470 iti eva kāraḥ jñāpayati itas uttaram samāveśaḥ bhavati iti

original: "ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartari ca' (sū.3-4-71) iti cakāro jñāpayati prāgamutaḥ samāveśo bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' iti sūtre evakāraḥ kimarthaḥ | na ca kṛtyādayo bhāvakarmaṇoreva yathā syuḥ kartari mā bhūvannityetadarthasūcanāya sa iti vācyam |
analyzed: ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartari ca sū iti cakāraḥ jñāpayati prāk amutas samāveśaḥ bhavati iti jhrviṭa nanu tayoḥ eva kṛtya kta khal arthāḥ iti sūtre eva kāraḥ kimarthaḥ na ca kṛtya ādayaḥ bhāva karmaṇoḥ eva yathā syuḥ kartari mā bhūvan iti etad artha sūcanāya saḥ iti vācyam

original: tayoriti sūtrasya "kartari kṛt' iti sāmānyaśāstrapavādatvādevoktārthasiddherityāśaṅkya, kṛtyapratyayeṣu kartrarthasyāpi samāveśo'stīti jñāpanārthamevakāraḥ | tathā ca kartrarthasyāpi samāveśe prāpte tannivṛttyarthamevakāra iti sbāṃśe cāritārthyam | anyatra prayojanaṃ tu bhavyādiṣu śabdeṣu karturapi pratītiriti |
analyzed: tayoḥ iti sūtrasya kartari kṛt iti sāmānya śāstra apavāda tvāt eva ukta artha siddheḥ iti āśaṅkya kṛtya pratyayeṣu kartṛ arthasya api samāveśaḥ usti iti jñāpana artham evakāraḥ tathā ca kartṛ arthasya api samāveśe prāpte tad nivṛtti artham evakāraḥ iti sba aṃśe cāritārthyam anyatra prayojanam tu bhavya ādiṣu śabdeṣu kartuḥ api pratītiḥ iti

original: ata eva goyo māṇavakaḥ sāmnāmiti kartari, geyāni māṇavakena sāmānīti karmaṇi ca prayoga upapadyate | tadāha--tayorevetyevakāra iti | tathā ca bhavyageyeti sūtre (sū.3-4-68) vāgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu yadyevaṃ jñāpyate tadā "dāśagoghnau saṃpradāne' (sū.3-4-73) "bhīmādayo'pādāne (sū.3-4-74) ityatrāpi samāveśaḥ prāpnoti |
analyzed: atas eva goyaḥ māṇavakaḥ sāmnām iti kartari geyāni māṇavakena sāmāni iti karmaṇi ca prayogaḥ upapadyate tad āhatayoḥ eva iti eva kāraḥ iti tathā ca bhavya geya iti sūtre sū vā grahaṇam na kartavyam iti bhāvaḥ nanu yadi evam jñāpyate tadā dāśa goghnau saṃpradāne sū bhīma ādayaḥ upādāne sū iti atra api samāveśaḥ prāpnoti

original: tathā ca kartaryapi teṣāṃ prayogaḥ syādityata jñāha--ādikarmaṇītyādinā | athaṃ bhāvaḥ--ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartarītyevāstu nārthaścaśabdena | evakārajñāpitāt pūrvoktavacanādeva caśabdārthasya samāveśasya siddheḥ | kṛtastu cakāro jñāpayati ādikarmaṇi ityetasmātpareṣu sūtreṣu kartrā samāveśo na bhavatīti |
analyzed: tathā ca kartari api teṣām prayogaḥ syāt iti atas bhāvaḥ ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartari iti eva astu na arthaḥ caśabdena evakāra jñāpitāt pūrva ukta vacanāt eva caśabda arthasya samāveśasya siddheḥ kṛtaḥ tu cakāraḥ jñāpayati ādikarmaṇi iti etasmāt pareṣu sūtreṣu kartrā samāveśaḥ na bhavati iti

original: tathā ca dāśagoghnādiṣu na kartrarthasamāveśa iti | iti tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ
analyzed: tathā ca dāśa goghna ādiṣu na kartṛ artha samāveśaḥ iti iti tṛtīyaḥ udhyāyaḥ

original: atha cacurtho'dhyāyaḥ
analyzed: atha cacurthaḥ udhyāyaḥ

original: jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ṭhapuṃyogāt ākhyāyām ' (sū.4-1-48) iti ṅīṣvidhānāt jñāpakāt nātaḥ (praṣṭhaśabdāt) taddhitotpattiriti | jhrvi.ṭa puṃyogādākhyāyām ' sūtrasya praṣṭhī pracarī ityūdāharaṇaṃ pradarśitaṃ bhāṣye | praṣṭhasya strī ityarthe praṣṭhaśabdāt ṅīṣ |
analyzed: iti ṅīṣ vidhānāt jñāpakāt na atas praṣṭha śabdāt taddhita utpattiḥ iti pum yogāt ākhyāyām sūtrasya praṣṭhī pracarī pum udāharaṇam pradarśitam bhāṣye praṣṭhasya strī iti arthe praṣṭha śabdāt ṅīṣ

original: nanu praṣṭhasya strī ityarthe "tasyedam' ityarthasadbhāvāt aṇrūpastaddhitaḥ prāpnotītyāśaṅkyāha--iti ṅīṣvidānāditi | yadi hi praṣṭhaśabdāt niyamena taddhitotpattirbhavet tarhi aṇṇantatvāt "ṭiḍhḍhaṇañ' (sū.4-1-15) iti sūtrema ṅīpaiva prāṣṭhī iti rūpasiddhau "puṃyogādāśyāyām' iti ṅīṣvidhānamanarthakamāpadyeta |
analyzed: nanu praṣṭhasya strī iti arthe tasya idam iti artha sadbhāvāt aṇ rūpaḥ taddhitaḥ prāpnoti iti āśaṅkya āha eti ṅī su idānāt iti yadi hi praṣṭha śabdāt niyamena taddhita utpattiḥ bhavet tarhi sū 4115 iti sūtra ima ṅīpā eva prāṣṭhī iti rūpa siddhau pum yogāt āśyāyām iti ṅī su idhānam anarthakam āpadyeta

original: na ca aṇantānṅīpi ṅīṣi vā rūpe viśeṣaḥ | nāpi svare, ṅīṣa udāttatvavat ṅīpo'pi "anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' iti sūtreṇa udāttatvāt | tataśca ṅīṣvidānaṃ vyarthaṃ sat na praṣṭhaśabdāttaddhitotpattirbhavatīti jñāpayati iti bhāvaḥ | na ca bānoriyamityarthe bhānuśabdāt "vṛddhācchaḥ' (sū.4-2-114) iti sūtrema chapratyaye ṭāpi bhānaviyā iti bhavata |
analyzed: na ca a ṇ antāt ṅīpi ṅīṣi vā rūpe viśeṣaḥ na api svare ṅīṣaḥ udātta tva vat anudāttasya ca yatra udātta lopaḥ iti sūtreṇa udātta tvāt tatas ca ṅīṣu idānam vyartham sat na praṣṭha śabdāt taddhita utpattiḥ bhavati iti jñāpayati iti bhāvaḥ na ca bānoḥ iyam iti arthe bhānu śabdāt vṛddhāt śaḥ sū 42114 iti cha pratyaye iti iti bhavata iti

original: tatra ṭāpaṃ bādhitvā ṅīṣvidhānārthaṃ puṃyogāditi sūtramastu| tathā ca kathaṃ tajjñāpakamiti vācyam | tarhi ākhyāgrahaṇavairyathyāt | tat vyarthaṃ sat jñāpayati taddhitotpattimantareṇaiva yaḥ puṃvācakaḥ śabdaḥ striyāṃ vartate tataḥ ṅīṣ iti |
analyzed: tatra ṭāpam bādhitvā ṅīṣ vidhāna artham pum yogāt iti sūtram astu tathā ca katham tat jñāpakam iti vācyam tarhi ākhyā grahaṇa vairyathyāt tat vyartham sat jñāpayati taddhita utpattim antareṇa eva yaḥ pum vācakaḥ śabdaḥ striyām vartate tatas ṅīṣ iti

original: bhānavīyā ityatra yaḥ puṃvācakaḥ bhānuśabdaḥ sa na striyāṃ vartate, yaśca striyāṃ vartate chapratyayāntaḥ sa na pumākhyā iti tatra na ṅīṣ | praṣṭhaśabdastu taddhitaṃ vinaiva satrīvācakatvāt tataḥ ṅīṣ bhavati | tena praṣṭhaśabdānna taddhita iti parthavasitamiti hṛdayam | jhrjñā.pā.ṭa svāṅgāccopasarjanāt (sū.4-2-54) ||
analyzed: bhānavīyāḥ iti atra yaḥ pum vācakaḥ bhānu śabdaḥ sa na striyām vartate yaḥ ca striyām vartate chapratyaya antaḥ sa na pum ākhyāḥ iti tatra na praṣṭha śabdaḥ tu taddhitam vinā eva satrī vācaka tvāt tatas bhavati tena praṣṭha śabdāt na taddhitaḥ iti parthavasitam iti hṛdayam sva aṅgāt ca upasarjanāt sū 4254

original: "sahanañvidyamānapūrvācca' (sū.4-2-57) iti pratiṣedāt jñāpakāt ānantodāttādapi bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "svāṅgāccopasarjanādasaṃyogopadhāt' iti sūtre upasarjanāditi vyartham | "bahuvrīheścāntodāttāt' (4-1-52) iti sūtrāt bahuvrīherityanuvṛttyaiva upasarjanādityasya lābhāt |
analyzed: saha nañ vidyamāna pūrvāt ca sū iti pratiṣedāt jñāpakāt ān anta udāttāt api bhavati iti jhrviṭa nanu sva aṅgāt ca upasarjanāt a saṃyoga upadhāt iti sūtre upasarjanāt iti vyartham bahuvrīheḥ ca anta udāttāt 4152 iti sūtrāt bahuvrīheḥ iti anuvṛttyā eva upasarjanāt ityasya lābhāt

original: na ca saṃniyogaśiṣṭanyāyena antodāttādityasyāpyanuvṛttirbhavediti tadvāraṇārtham "upasarjanāt' ityupādīyate | upātte ca tasmiṃstadbalāt upasarjanamātrāt svāṅgadantodāttādanantodāttādapi ṅīṣ bhaviṣyatīti vācyam | jñāpakamahimnaiva antodāttādityasya "svāṅgācca' iti sūtre'nuvṛttirnāstītyavagamāt | jñāpakamāha--sahanañvidyamāneti |
analyzed: na ca saṃniyoga śiṣṭa nyāyena anta udāttāt iti asya api anuvṛttiḥ bhavet iti tad vāraṇa artham upasarjanāt iti upādīyate upātte ca tasmin tad balāt upasarjana mātrāt sva aṅga danta udāttāt ananta udāttāt api ṅīṣ bhaviṣyati iti vācyam jñāpaka mahimnā eva anta udāttāt iti asya sva aṅgāt ca iti sūtre anuvṛttiḥ na asti iti avagamāt jñāpakam āha saha nañ vidyamāna iti

original: sahetyāditrikapūrvātsvāṅgāt ṅīṣ niṣidhyate | sakeśā akeśā vidyamānanāsikā ityudāharaṇāni | tatra sahādipūrvasya bahuvrīheḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvare śeṣanighātena svāṅgasya nāstyantodāttatvamiti "svāṅgāccopasarjanāt ' ityanena ṅīṣaḥ prāptyabhāvāt prataṣiedho'narthakaḥ san antodāttādityasyānuvṛttyabhāvaṃ jñāpayati |
analyzed: saha ityādi trika pūrvāt sva aṅgāt niṣidhyate sa keśā akeśā vidyamāna nāsikā iti udāharaṇāni tatra saha ādi pūrvasya bahuvrīheḥ pūrva pada prakṛti svare śeṣa nighātena sva aṅgasya na asti anta udātta tvam iti sva aṅgāt ca upasarjanāt iti anena ṅīṣaḥ prāpti abhāvāt san anta udāttāt ityasya anuvṛtti abhāvam jñāpayati

original: tathā cānantodāttādapi sahādipūrvāt ṅīṣprāptau tatpratiṣedhakatayā sahanañsūtraṃ sārthakam | tathā ca bahuvrīherityetāvanmātrasyānuvṛttyaiva upasarjanādityasya lābhasaṃbhavāt upasarjanagrahaṇaṃ māstu ityāśayaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ḍhaki lopaḥ (sū.4-1-133)|| etadeva jñāpayati bhavati pitṛṣvasurḍhak iti |
analyzed: tathā ca ananta udāttāt api saha ādi pūrvāt ṅīṣ prāptau tad pratiṣedhaka tayā saha nañ sūtram sārthakam tathā ca bahuvrīheḥ iti etāvat mātrasya anuvṛttyā eva upasarjanāt ityasya lābha saṃbhavāt upasarjana grahaṇam mā astu iti āśayaḥ ḍhaki lopaḥ sū41133 etat eva jñāpayati bhavati pitṛṣvasuḥ ḍhak iti

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu pitṛṣvasṛśabdāta "ḍhaki lopaḥ' iti sūtreṇāntyasya ṛkārasya lope paitṛṣvaseya iti rūpamiṣyate | tanna sidhyati | pitṛṣvasṛśabdāt ḍhagvidhāyakānuśāsanābhāvādityata āha-- etadeveti |
analyzed: nanu pitṛṣvasṛ śabdāt ḍhaki lopaḥ iti sūtreṇa antyasya ṛkārasya lope paitṛṣvaseyaḥ iti rūpam iṣyate tat na sidhyati pitṛṣvasṛ śabdāt ḍhak vidhāyaka anuśāsana abhāvāt iti atas āha etat eva iti

original: pitṛṣvasṛśabdāt ḍhako'bhāve ḍhaki pare tasya lopavidhānamasaṃgataṃ syāditi ḍhaki lopavidhānameva pitṛṣvasṛśambdāt ḍhak bhavatītyatra bhavatītyatra jñāpakamiti bhāvaḥ | anena jñāpakena śubhrādiṣu pitṛṣvasṛśbdapāṭhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ | yadvā "strībhyo ḍhat' (sū.4-1-120) ityatra strībhya ityarthagrahaṇamiti jñāpanīyam |
analyzed: pitṛṣvasṛ śabdāt ḍhakaḥ ubhāve ḍhaki pare tasya lopa vidhānam asaṃgatam syāt iti ḍhaki lopa vidhānam eva pitṛṣvasṛ śabdāt ḍhak bhavati iti atra bhavati iti atra jñāpakam iti bhāvaḥ anena jñāpakena śubhra ādiṣu pitṛṣvasṛ śbda pāṭhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ yat vā strībhyaḥ iti artha grahaṇam iti jñāpanīyam

original: ataḥ pitṛṣvasurḍhaksiddhiriti udyotakāraḥ pratyapādayat | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa
analyzed: atas pitṛṣvasuḥ ḍhak siddhiḥ iti udyota kāraḥ pratyapādayat jhrjñāpaṭa

original: brāhmaṇamāṇava-(sū.4-2-42)|| yañi prakṛte yanvidhānaṃ jñāpayati anyebhyo'pyayamiti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "brāhmaṇamāṇavavāḍaḍḍatdh;vādyan' iti sūtreṇa brāhmaṇādibhyaḥ samūhārthe yan vidhīyate | brāhmaṇānāṃ samūho brāhmaṇyamityādikamudāharaṇam | tatra sūtre yan iti māstu | "kedārādyañca' (sū.4-2-40) iti sūtrāt yañ ityasyānuvṛtyā iṣṭarūpasiddheḥ |
analyzed: brāhmaṇa māṇava sū yañi prakṛte yan vidhānam jñāpayati anyebhyaḥ api ayam iti nanu iti sūtreṇa brāhmaṇa ādibhyaḥ samūha arthe yan vidhīyate brāhmaṇānām samūhaḥ brāhmaṇyam iti ādikam udāharaṇam tatra sūtre yan iti mā astu kedārāt yañ ca sū iti sūtrāt yañ iti asya anuvṛtyā iṣṭa rūpa siddheḥ

original: na hiyaño vā yano vā rūpe svare vā viśeṣo'sti | na ca yañi sati striyāṃ ""yañaśca' (sū.4-1-16) iti ṅīp syāt, yani tu neti viśeṣa iti vācyam | kaumudyāṃ apatyādhikārīyayañantādeva ṅīp ityuktatvāt | brāhmaṇādīnāṃ svata eva vṛddhatvena yañi satyādivṛddhirna tu yani satītyasyāpi viśeṣasyāsaṃbhavādityāśaṅkyāha--yañi prakṛta iti |
analyzed: na hi yañaḥ vā yanaḥ vā rūpe svare vā viśeṣaḥ asti na ca yañi sati striyām yañaḥ ca iti ṅīp syāt yani tu na iti viśeṣaḥ iti vācyam kaumudyām apatya adhikārīya yañ antāt eva ṅīp iti ukta tvāt brāhmaṇa ādīnām svatas eva vṛddha tvena yañi sati ādi vṛddhiḥ na tu yani sati iti asya api viśeṣasya asaṃbhavāt iti āśaṅkya āha yañi prakṛte iti

original: tathā ca vyarthaṃ sat yangrahamaṃ brāhmaṇādibyo'nyebhyo'pi yan bhavatīti jñāpayati | tena pṭaṣṭhānāṃ samūhaḥ pṛṣṭhyamiti sidhyati | tatra ca yañi satyādivṛddhirbhavediti yangrahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti cāritārthyam | evaṃ ca "pṛṣṭhādupasaṃkhyānam' iti vārtikaṃ na kartavyam, jñāpakenaiva siddheriti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa khaṇḍiḍḍatdh;kādibhyaśca (sū.4-2-45)||
analyzed: tathā ca vyartham sat bhavati iti jñāpayati tena pṭaṣṭhānām samūhaḥ pṛṣṭhyam iti sidhyati tatra ca sati ādi vṛddhiḥ bhavet iti yan grahaṇam kṛtam iti cāritārthyam evam ca pṛṣṭhāt upasaṃkhyānam iti vārtikam na kartavyam jñāpakena eva siddheḥ iti bhāvaḥ khaṇḍiḍḍatdhka ādibhyaḥ ca sū 4245 ca

original: khaṇḍiḍḍatdh;kādiṣu kṣudrakamālavaśabdapāṭho jñāpayati bhavatīha tadantavidhiriti pūrvaśca vuñū paramañaṃ bādhata iti ca | anyathānupapattyā ekasyevobhayasyāpi jñāpanaṃ na virudhyate | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "khaṇḍiḍḍatdh;kādibhyaśca' iti sūtreṇa samūhārthe añ vidhīyate | khaṇḍiḍḍatdh;kādigaṇe ca kṣudrakamālavaśabgadaḥ paṭhyate | tasya pāṭhaḥ kimarthaḥ |
analyzed: khaṇḍiḍḍatdhka ādiṣu kṣudraka mālava śabda pāṭhaḥ jñāpayati bhavati iha tad anta vidhiḥ iti pūrvaḥ ca param añam bādhate iti ca anyathā anupapattyā ekasya iva ubhayasya api jñāpanam na virudhyate nanu khaṇḍiḍḍatdhka ādibhyaḥ ca iti sūtreṇa samūha arthe añ vidhīyate khaṇḍiḍḍatdhka ādi gaṇe ca kṣudraka mālava śabda gadaḥ paṭhyate tasya pāṭhaḥ kimarthaḥ

original: "anudāttāderañ' (sū.4-2-44) ityanevaiva tato'ñsiddheḥ | kṣudrakamālavaśabdasyānudāttāditvaṃ cettham | kṣudrakasyāpatyānītyarthe "janapadaśabdāt' (sū.4-1-168) iti vihitasya tadrājasya luk | mālavāttu vṛddhalakṣaṇasya ñyaṅaḥ | tato dvandvaḥ | tataḥ samāsāntodāttatvenānudāttāditvamiti kaiyaṭaḥ | tataḥ samūharthe añ |
analyzed: anudātta ādeḥ añ sū4244 iti an eva eva tatas uñ siddheḥ kṣudraka mālava śabdasya anudātta ādi tvam ca ittham kṣudrakasya apatyāni iti arthe janapada śabdāt sū41168 iti vihitasya tad rājasya luk mālavāt tu vṛddha lakṣaṇasya ñyaṅaḥ tatas dvandvaḥ tatas samāsa anta udātta tvena anudātta ādi tvam iti kaiyaṭaḥ tatas samūha arthe añ iti

original: na ca "gotrokṣoṣṭra' (sū.4-2-39) iti sūtraprāptavuñbādhanārthaṃ tatpāṭhaiti vācyam | "anudāttāderañ' ityasya paratvena tadviṣaye pūrvasya vuño'saṃbhavāt, gotrādvihitasya vuñaḥ gotrāntāt kṣudakamālavaśabdāt prāptyabhāvācca ityāśaṅkya, ata eva pāṭho jñāpayati "pūrvo'pi vuñ paramañaṃ bāghate' "bhavatīha tadantavidhiḥ' iti ca vacanadvayam |
analyzed: na ca gotra ukṣa uṣṭra iti sūtra prāpta vuñ bādhana artham tad pāṭhaḥ eti vācyam anudātta ādeḥ añ iti asya paratvena tad viṣaye pūrvasya vuñaḥ saṃbhavāt gotrāt vihitasya vuñaḥ gotra antāt kṣudaka mālava śabdāt prāpti abhāvāt ca iti āśaṅkya atas eva pāṭhaḥ jñāpayati pūrvaḥ api vuñ param añam bāghate bhavati iha tad anta vidhiḥ iti ca vacana dvayam

original: tathāca vuñaṃ bādhitvā samūhārthe añaḥ kṣudvakamālavaśabdapāṭha iti bhāṣye siddhāntitam | tadāha--khaṇḍiḍḍatdh;kādiṣvityādinā | nanu kathamekena vacanadvayaṃ jñāpyetetyaśaṅkyāha--anyathānupapacyeti | anyathānupapattyā hi jñāpakatvaṃ bhavati | ubhayena ca vinā kṣudrakamālavādañvidhānaṃ nopapadyataityubhayamapi jñāpayituṃ śakyamiti bhāvaḥ |

original: jhrjñā.pa.ṭa jāgro'vi (sū.7-3-85)|| ciṇṇaloḥ pratiṣedho jñāpayati na guṇābhinirvṛttasya vṛddhirbhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu jāgṛdhātorṇijantāllaṭi jāgarayatītyatra jāgṛ i ati iti sthite ṛkārasya "jāgro'viciṇṇalṅitsu' iti sūtreṇa guṇe rapare sati jāgar i ati iti sthite "ata upadhāyāḥ' (sū. 7-2-116) iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti ityāśaṅkyāha--ciṇṇaloriti |

original: kṛtaśca pratiṣedho jñāpayati guṇaśabdena niṣpanno yo'kāraḥ tasya ata upadhāyā iti vṛddhirna bhavatīti | evaṃ ca ciṇṇalorjāgro guṇe sati tadabhinirvṛttasya akārasya vṛddhirna bhavediti tayorguṇapratiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ | tataśca guṇābhāve "aco ñṇiti ' iti vṛddhau ajāgāri jajāgāra iti rūpasiddhiriti svāṃśe caritārthatā |
analyzed: kṛtaḥ ca pratiṣedhaḥ jñāpayati guṇa śabdena niṣpannaḥ ya okāraḥ tasya atas upadhāyāḥ iti vṛddhiḥ na bhavati iti evam ca ciṇ ṇaloḥ jāgraḥ guṇe sati tad abhinirvṛttasya akārasya vṛddhiḥ na bhavet iti tayoḥ guṇa pratiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ tatas ca guṇa abhāve a caḥ ñ ṇ iti iti vṛddhau ajāgāri jajāgāra iti rūpa siddhiḥ iti sva aṃśe caritārtha tā

original: jñāpanaprayojanaṃ tu jāgarayatītyādau ata upadhāyā iti vṛddhiḥ na bhavatīti ityāśayaḥ || jhrjñā.pa.ṭa puganta (sū.7-3-96)|| knusanoḥ kitkaraṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ bhavatyevaṃjātīyakānāṃ guṇa iti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu bhidestṛci tumuni ca bhettā bhettumityatra "pugantalaghūpadhasya ca' iti guṇo na sidhyati |
analyzed: jñāpana prayojanam tu jāgarayati ityādau atas upadhāyāḥ iti vṛddhiḥ na bhavati iti iti āśayaḥ knu sanoḥ kit karaṇam jñāpakam bhavati evaṃjātīyakānām guṇaḥ iti nanu bhideḥ tṛci tumuni ca bhettā bhettum iti atra puk anta laghu upadhasya ca iti guṇaḥ na sidhyati

original: bhid tṛ, bhid tum ityatra dhātvantapratyayādyorhaloranantarayoḥ saṃyogasaṃjñāyāṃ "saṃyoge guru' (sū.1-4-11) iti ikārasya gurusaṃjñayā laghusaṃjñāyā bādhāt upadhāyā ikārasya laghutvābhāvādityāśaṅkyāha--knusanoriti | "trasigṛdhidhṛṣikṣipeḥ knuḥ' (sū.3-2-140) iti sūtre knoḥ kitkaraṇaṃ gṛdhnuḥ ityādau upadhāguṇapratiṣedhārtham |
analyzed: bhid tṛ bhid tum iti atra dhātu anta pratyaya ādyoḥ ha loḥ anantarayoḥ saṃyoga saṃjñāyām saṃyoge guru sū1411 iti ikārasya guru saṃjñayā laghu saṃjñāyāḥ bādhāt upadhāyāḥ ikārasya laghu tva abhāvāt iti āśaṅkya āha knu sanoḥ iti trasi gṛdhi dhṛṣi kṣipeḥ knuḥ sū32140 iti sūtre knoḥ kit karaṇam gṛdhnuḥ ityādau upadhā guṇa pratiṣedha artham

original: tatrāpi dhātvantapratyayādyorhaloḥ saṃyogasaṃjñāyāṃ"saṃyoge guru' iti ṛkārasya gurusaṃjñayā laghusaṃjñāyāḥ bādhāt upadhāyāḥ laghutvābhāvādeva guṇāpravṛtteḥ guṇaniṣedhaphalakaṃ kitkaraṇamanarthakam |
analyzed: tatra api dhātu anta pratyaya ādyoḥ ha loḥ saṃyoga saṃjñāyām saṃyoge guru iti ṛkārasya guru saṃjñayā laghu saṃjñāyāḥ bādhāt upadhāyāḥ laghu tva abhāvāt eva guṇa apravṛtteḥ guṇa niṣedha phalakam kit karaṇam anarthakam

original: evaṃ "halantācca' (sū.1-2-10) iti sūtreṇa iksamīpāddhalaḥ parasya jhalādeḥ sanaḥ kittvavidhānaṃ bhibhitsatītyādau guṇaniṣedhaphalakaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ vyartham | dhātvantadakārapratyayādisakārayoḥ saṃyogasaṃjñāyāṃ tasmin pare ikārasya gurutvena laghutvābhāvādeva guṇāpravṛtteḥ |
analyzed: evam ha l antāt ca sū1210 iti sūtreṇa i k samīpāt ha laḥ parasya jha l ādeḥ sanaḥ k it tva vidhānam bhibhitsati ityādau guṇa niṣedha phalakam kriyamāṇam vyartham dhātu anta dakāra pratyaya ādi sakārayoḥ saṃyoga saṃjñāyām tasmin pare ikārasya guru tvena laghu tva abhāvāt eva guṇa apravṛtteḥ

original: tathā ca knusanoḥ kitkaraṇaṃ vyarthaṃ sat evaṃjātīyakānāṃ--dhātvantapratyayādyorhaloḥ saṃyogasaṃjñāṃ nimittīkṛtya labdhaguruvyapadeśānāmikāṃ guṇo bhavatīti jñāpayati | evaṃ ca guṇaprāptau tanniṣedhaphalakaṃ kitkaraṇaṃ sārthakaṃ bhavati | jñiāpanaphalaṃ tu bhettā bhettumityādau guṇasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ
analyzed: tathā ca knu sanoḥ kit karaṇam vyartham sat evaṃjātīyakānām dhātu anta pratyaya ādyoḥ ha loḥ saṃyoga saṃjñām nimittīkṛtya labdha guru vyapadeśa ānāmikām guṇaḥ bhavati iti jñāpayati evam ca guṇa prāptau tad niṣedha phalakam kit karaṇam sārthakam bhavati jñiāpana phalam tu bhettā bhettum ityādau guṇa siddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: || jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ṭhaṅerāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ' (sū.7-3-116) iti pṛthagābgrahaṇāt nāpo nadīsaṃjñā bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhayū strayākhyau nadī' iti sūtreṇa nityastrīliṅgayorīdūdantayornadīsaṃjñā ucyate |
analyzed: ṭha ṅeḥ ām nadī ām nībhyaḥ sū 73116 iti pṛthak āp grahaṇāt nāpaḥ nadī saṃjñā bhavati iti jhrviṭa ṭhayū nadī iti sūtreṇa nitya strī liṅgayoḥ ī t ū t antayoḥ nadī saṃjñā ucyate

original: tatra yū ityanuktau khaṭvā mālā ityādeḥ nityastrīliṅgasya ṭābantasyāpi nadīsaṃjñāyāṃ khaṭravābandhuḥ mālābandhuḥ ityatra "nadī bandhuni' (sū.6-2-109) iti sūtreṇa pūrvapadāntodāttasvaraḥ prasajyeta | iṣyate tu khaṭeḥ auṇādike kvani khaṭvāśabdaniṣpatteḥ īdūdantatvābāvāt nadīsaṃjñāyā aprāptyāna pūrvoktadoṣa iti yū ityasya prayojanaṃ vaktavyam |
analyzed: tatra iti anuktau khaṭvā mālā ityādeḥ nitya strī liṅgasya ṭāp antasya api nadī saṃjñāyām mālābandhuḥ iti atra nadī bandhuni sū62109 iti sūtreṇa pūrva pada anta udātta svaraḥ prasajyeta iṣyate tu khaṭeḥ auṇādike kvani khaṭvā śabda niṣpatteḥ ī t ū t anta tva abāvāt nadī saṃjñāyāḥ aprāptyāḥ na pūrva ukta doṣaḥ iti iti asya prayojanam vaktavyam

original: tattu prayojanaṃ jñāpakena ābantasya nadīsaṃjñāyāḥ vārayituṃ śakyatvādayuktam | tathā hi--yadi ābantasyāpi nadīsaṃjñā syāt tarhi "ṅerāmnadyāmnībyaḥ' iti sūtre nadī ityanenaiva ābantasyāpi grahaṇe siddhe pṛthak ābgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt | kṛtaṃ ca tat ābantasya nadīsaṃjñā na bavatīti jñāpayati | tadetadāha--iti pṛthagiti |
analyzed: tat tu prayojanam jñāpakena āp antasya nadī saṃjñāyāḥ vārayitum śakya tvāt ayuktam tathā hi yadi āp antasya api nadī saṃjñā syāt tarhi ṅeḥ āp nadī āp nībyaḥ iti sūtre nadī iti anena eva āp antasya api grahaṇe siddhe pṛthak āp grahaṇam anarthakam syāt kṛtam ca tat āp antasya nadī saṃjñā na jñāpayati tat etat āha eti pṛthak iti

original: tathā ca ābantasya nadīsaṃjñāvāraṇaphalakatvaṃ thūityasya na bhavatīti mātre mātuḥ ityatra ṛkārāntasya nadītvavāraṇameva tatphalaṃ vaktavyam | tasya hi nadītve "āṇ nadyāḥ' iti tataḥ parasya ṅitaḥ āḍaḍḍatdh;āgamo bhavediti bhāṣye sthitam | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ṛtaśca (sū.7-4-92)|| aṅgaviśeṣaṇametadityatra taparakaraṇaṃ jñāpakam |
analyzed: tathā ca āp antasya nadī saṃjñā vāraṇa phalaka tvam na bhavati iti mātre mātuḥ iti atra ṛkāra antasya nadī tva vāraṇam eva tad phalam vaktavyam tasya hi nadī tve āṭ nadyāḥ iti tatas parasya ṅ itaḥ bhavet iti bhāṣye sthitam jhrjñāpaṭaḥ ṛ taḥ ca sū7492 aṅga viśeṣaṇam etat iti atra ta para karaṇam jñāpakam

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "ṛtaśca'(sū.7-4-92) iti sūtre ṛta ityetat kimaṅgaviśeṣaṇam āhosvidabhyāsaviśeṣaṇam | abhyāsaviśeṣaṇatvapakṣe dhātoravayavasya ṛdantasyābhyāsasya ruk rik rīk āgamāḥ yaṅluki syuriti sūtrārthaḥ | aṅgaviśeṣaṇatvapakṣe ṛkārāntasya dhātoravayavasyābyāssya uktāgamāḥ syurati sūtrārthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu iti sūtre ṛ taḥ iti etat kim aṅga viśeṣaṇam āhosvit abhyāsa viśeṣaṇam abhyāsa viśeṣaṇa tva pakṣe dhātoḥ avayavasya ṛ t antasya abhyāsasya ruc rik rīk āgamāḥ yaṅ luki syuḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ aṅga viśeṣaṇa tva pakṣe ṛkāra antasya dhātoḥ avayavasya ukta āgamāḥ syuḥ ati sūtra arthaḥ

original: kataraḥ pakṣo'tra nyāyya ityāśaṅkya aṅgaviśeṣaṇamityāha-- aṅgaviśeṣaṇamiti | atra sūtre taparakāraṇābhāve "kṝ vikṣepe' iti dhātoryaṅluki cākartītyatra abyāsasya rugādyāgamaḥ prāpnuyāt |
analyzed: kataraḥ pakṣaḥ atra nyāyyaḥ iti āśaṅkya aṅga viśeṣaṇam iti āha aṅga viśeṣaṇam iti atra sūtre ta para kāraṇa abhāve vikṣepe iti dhātoḥ yaṅ luki ca ākarti iti atra a byāsasya ruj ādi āgamaḥ prāpnuyāt

original: kṝ yaṅluk ti iti sthite dhātordvitvekṝ kṝ ti iti sthite abhyāsahrasve "urat' ityabhyāsasya akāre kar kṝ ti iti jāte halādiśeṣe cutve "dīrgho'kitaḥ'(sū.7-4-83) iti abhyāsasya dīrghe cākṝti iti sthite "sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' iti ṛkārasya guṇe ca cākartīti rūpaṃ sidhyati | tatra ṛkārasyābhyāsaviśeṣaṇatvapakṣe taparakaraṇaṃ vyartham |
analyzed: kṝ yaṅ luk ti iti sthite dhātoḥ dvi tve kṝ kṝ ti iti sthite abhyāsa hrasve urat iti abhyāsasya akāre kṝ ti iti jāte ha l ādi śeṣe cu tve iti abhyāsasya dīrghe iti sthite sārvadhātuka ārdhadhātukayoḥ iti ṛkārasya guṇe ca iti rūpam sidhyati tatra ṛkārasya abhyāsa viśeṣaṇa tva pakṣe ta para karaṇam vyartham

original: abhyāsasthadīrghaṝrāpavyāvartanaṃ hi tatphalam | na hyabhyāse dīrghaḥ saṃbhavati | "hrasvaḥ' (sū.7-4-59) iti sūtreṇa hrasvaprāpteḥ | tathā ca taparakāraṇaṃ jñāpayati aṅgaviśeṣaṇametat iti |
analyzed: abhyāsa stha dīrgha ṝ rāpa vyāvartanam hi tad phalam na hi abhyāse dīrghaḥ saṃbhavati hrasvaḥ iti sūtreṇa hrasva prāpteḥ tathā ca ta para kāraṇam jñāpayati aṅga viśeṣaṇam etat iti

original: tatra ca taparakaraṇābhāve abhyāsahrasve'pi kṛ kṝ ityaṅgasya dīrghāntasya saṃbhavāt tadavayavābhyāsasya rugādyāgame sati carkarti carikarti carīkarti iti rūpāṇi kṝdhātorbhaveyuḥ | iṣyate tu cākartīti rūpam | atastaparakaraṇaṃ kṛtam | kṛte ca tasmin kṛ kṝ ityaṅgasya hrasvaṛkārāntatvāsaṃbhavāt na tadavayavābhyāsasya rugādyāgamaprāptiriti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: tatra ca ta para karaṇa abhāve abhyāsa hrasve api kṛ kṝ iti aṅgasya dīrgha antasya saṃbhavāt tad avayava abhyāsasya ruj ādi āgame sati carkarti carikarti carīkarti iti rūpāṇi kṝ dhātoḥ bhaveyuḥ iṣyate tu cākarti iti rūpam atas ta para karaṇam kṛtam kṛte ca tasmin kṛ kṝ iti aṅgasya hrasva ṛkāra anta tva asaṃbhavāt na tad avayava abhyāsasya ruj ādi āgama prāptiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: jhrjñā.pa.ṭa sanvallaghuni (sū.7-4-93)|| "atsamṛdṛtvara'(sū.7-4-95) iti itvabādhanārthatvavidhānaṃ jñāpayati bhavati saṃyogavyavahitānāmitvamiti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "sanvallaghuni caṅpare'naglope' iti sūtreṇa caṅpare ṇo yallaghu tasmin parato'bhyāsasya sanvatkarthaṃ bhavatītyucyate | evaṃ ca acikṣaṇat ityatra abhyāsasya itvaṃ na prāpnoti |
analyzed: san vat laghuni sū iti i tva bādhana artha tva vidhānam jñāpayati bhavati saṃyoga vyavahitānām itvam iti nanu san vat laghuni caṅ para nak lope iti sūtreṇa caṅ pare ṇaḥ yat laghu tasmin paratas bhyāsasya san vat kartham bhavati iti ucyate evam ca acikṣaṇat iti atra abhyāsasya i tvam na prāpnoti

original: kṣaṇadhātorṇijantāt laṅi aṭi caṅi dvitve halādiśeṣe cutve ca acakṣaṇ i at ityatra caṅpare ṇau yallaghu kṣa ityatra akāraḥ tatparakatvamabhyāsasya nāsti saṃyogasaṃjñakakakāraṣakāravyavadhānāt ityaśaṅkyāha--itvabādhanārthetyādi |
analyzed: kṣaṇa dhātoḥ ṇic antāt laṅi aṭi caṅi dvitve ha l ādi śeṣe cu tve ca acakṣaṇ i a t iti atra caṅ pare ṇau yat laghu iti atra akāraḥ tad paraka tvam abhyāsasya na asti saṃyoga saṃjñaka kakāra ṣakāra vyavadhānāt iti aśaṅkya āha aitva bādhana artha ityādi

original: athaṃ bhāvaḥ- "atsamṛdṛtvaraprathamradastṝspaśām' (sū.7-4-95) iti sūtreṇa samṛ ityādīnāṃ dhātūnāmabhyāsasya akāro'ntādeśo vidhīyate caṅpare ṇau pare | asasmarat ityādikamudāharaṇam | "sanvallaghuni' iti
analyzed: bhāvaḥ sū 7495 iti sūtreṇa sam ṛ iti ādīnām dhātūnām abhyāsasya akāraḥ unta ādeśaḥ vidhīyate caṅ pare ṇau pare asasmarat iti ādikam udāharaṇam san vat laghuni iti

original: sūtreṇa sanvadbhāvātideśaprāptasya itvasya bādhanāya atvaṃ bidhīyate | tatra sakāramakārarūpasaṃyogavyavahitatvāt abhyāsasya caṅparaṇiparakalaghuparakatvaṃ nāstītyata eva sanvadbhāvābhāvena itvāprasakteḥ tadbādhanārthatayā vidhīyamānamatvaṃ vyarthaṃ sat jñāpayati saṃyogavyavahitānāmapi itvaṃ bhavatīti |
analyzed: sūtreṇa san vat bhāva atideśa prāptasya i tvasya bādhanāya a tvam bidhīyate tatra sakāra makāra rūpa saṃyoga vyavahita tvāt abhyāsasya caṅ paraṇi paraka laghu paraka tvam na asti iti atas eva san vat bhāva abhāvena i tva aprasakteḥ tad bādhana artha tayā vidhīyamānam atvam vyartham sat jñāpayati saṃyoga vyavahitānām api i tvam bhavati iti

original: tatā ca acikṣaṇat ityatra itvaṃ sulabhamiti bhāvaḥ || iti saptamo'dhyāyaḥ
analyzed: ca acikṣaṇat iti atra i tvam sulabham iti bhāvaḥ iti saptamaḥ adhyāyaḥ

original: atha aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
analyzed: atha aṣṭamaḥ udhyāyaḥ

original: jhrjñā.pa.ṭa padasya (sū.8-1-16)|| "nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (sū.8-2-7) iti antagrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhyeṣā na sthānaṣaṣṭhīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "padasye' tyadhikārasūtramuttarasūtreṣu saṃbadhnāti | tatra padasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhī vā viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhī veti saṃdehe āha--nalopa ityādinā |
analyzed: padasya sū 8116 na lopaḥ prātipadika antasya sū iti anta grahaṇam jñāpayati viśeṣaṇa ṣaṣṭhī eṣā na sthāna ṣaṣṭhī iti nanu padasya iti adhikāra sūtram uttara sūtreṣu saṃbadhnāti tatra padasya iti sthāna ṣaṣṭhī vā viśeṣaṇa ṣaṣṭhī vā iti saṃdehe āha na lopaḥ ityādinā

original: "nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' iti sūtre'pi padasyetyadhikriyate | yadi tatsthānaṣaṣṭhī syāt tadā antagrahaṇaṃ vyartham | tathāhi sati prātipadikasyeti padasyetyasya viśeṣaṇam | prātipadikasaṃjñakasya nāntasya padasya lopa iti sūtrārthaḥ | tatra cālontyaparibhāṣyā padāntasya nakārasya lopo bhaviṣyatīti kimantagrahaṇena |
analyzed: na lopaḥ prātipadika antasya iti sūtre api padasya iti adhikriyate yadi tad sthāna ṣaṣṭhī syāt tadā anta grahaṇam vyartham tathā hi sati prātipadikasya iti padasya iti asya viśeṣaṇam prātipadika saṃjñakasya na antasya padasya lopaḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ tatra pada antasya nakārasya lopaḥ bhaviṣyati iti kim anta grahaṇena

original: kṛtaṃ ca tat padasyeti viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhīti jñāpayati | tena padāvayavabhūtaṃ yatprātipadikaṃ tadavayavasya nasya lopa iti sūtrārthaḥ | tatra ca sthānaṣaṣṭhītvābhāvāt alo'ntyaparibhāṣāyāḥ anupasthitau antyasya nakārasya lopo na labhyeteti antagrahaṇaṃ antanakāralopārthaṃ kriyata iti svāṃśe cāritārthyam |
analyzed: kṛtam ca tat padasya iti viśeṣaṇa ṣaṣṭhī iti jñāpayati tena pada avayava bhūtam yat prātipadikam tad avayavasya nasya lopaḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ tatra ca sthāna ṣaṣṭhī tva abhāvāt a laḥ antya paribhāṣāyāḥ anupasthitau antyasya nakārasya lopaḥ na labhyeta iti anta grahaṇam anta nakāra lopa artham kriyate iti sva aṃśe cāritārthyam

original: viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhīti jñāpanasyānyatra prayojanaṃ tu "udāttasvaritayorthaṇaḥ svarito'nudāttasya' (sū.8-2-4) iti sūtre padasyetyadhikārāt tasya ca sthānaṣaṣṭhītve udāttasvaritayoryo yaṇ tataḥ paro yo'nudāttaḥ tadantasya padasya svaritatvamalo'ntyasya bhavatīti sūtrārthaḥ syāt |
analyzed: viśeṣaṇa ṣaṣṭhī iti jñāpanasya anyatra prayojanam tu svarita unudāttasya sū iti sūtre padasya iti adhikārāt tasya ca sthāna ṣaṣṭhī tve udātta svaritayoḥ yaḥ yaṇ tatas paraḥ yaḥ unudāttaḥ tad antasya padasya svarita tvam alaḥ antyasya bhavati iti sūtra arthaḥ syāt
