original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "nudavidondratrāghrāḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|nībhyo'nyatarasyām' iti sūtreṇa kiṃ nudādibhyaḥ parasya niṣṭhākārasya natvaṃ vikalpena vidhīyate, uta vikalpena pratiṣidhyate | kimayaṃ yogaḥ vidhiḥ uta niṣedha iti yāvat | tatra vidhiriti pakṣe naḥ iti vaktavyam | na ca "radābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ' iti sūtrāt (8-2-42) naḥ ityanuvartiṣyata iti vācyam |
analyzed: jhrviṭa nanu nuda vida undra trā ghrā ḍhaddha ṭhṭhaḍanībhyaḥ anyatarasyām iti sūtreṇa kim nuda ādibhyaḥ parasya niṣṭhā kārasya na tvam vikalpena vidhīyate uta vikalpena pratiṣidhyate kim ayam yogaḥ vidhiḥ uta niṣedhaḥ iti yāvat tatra vidhiḥ iti pakṣe naḥ iti vaktavyam na ca ra dābhyām niṣṭhā taḥ naḥ iti sūtrāt naḥ iti anuvartiṣyate iti vācyam

original: "śuṣaḥ kaḥ' "paco vaḥ' (sū.8-2-51,52) ityādibhiḥ nakārasya vyavacchinnatvāt | prātiṣedhapakṣe tu nudādibhyo niṣṭhātasya yat prāpnoti tanna bhavatītyantareṇāpi nakāragrahaṇaṃ nakārasya pratiṣedhaḥ sidhyati | paraṃtvatra pakṣe ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|nīgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ bhavati ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|nīdhātoḥ parasya niṣṭhātasya natvaprāptyabhāvāt |
analyzed: śuṣaḥ kaḥ pacaḥ vaḥ sū 825152 ityādibhiḥ nakārasya vyavacchinna tvāt prātiṣedha pakṣe tu nud ādibhyaḥ niṣṭhātasya yat prāpnoti tat na bhavati iti antareṇa api nakāra grahaṇam nakārasya pratiṣedhaḥ sidhyati paraṃtu atra pakṣe ḍhad haṭh ṭhaḍanī grahaṇam anarthakam bhavati ḍhad haṭh ṭhaḍanī dhātoḥ parasya niṣṭhātasya na tva prāpti abhāvāt

original: nudādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ "radābhyāṃ' ityanena trā ghnā ityanayoḥ "saṃyogāderāto dhāroryaṇvataḥ' (sū.8-2-43) ityanena prāptesteṣāṃ niṣedho yuktaḥ na tu ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|nīdhātoḥ, ataḥ kataraḥ pakṣaḥ āśrayaṇīya ityāśaṅkya, vidhipakṣaṃ sarmathya pratiṣedhapakṣo'pi "athavā punarastu pratiṣedhaḥ' ityādinā bhāṣye samāśritaḥ |
analyzed: nud ādīnām trayāṇām ra dābhyām iti anena ghnāḥ iti anayoḥ saṃyoga ādeḥ ā taḥ dhāroḥ yaṇvataḥ sū 8243 iti anena prāpteḥ teṣām niṣedhaḥ yuktaḥ na tu ḍhad dhaṭh ṭhaḍanī dhātoḥ atas kataraḥ pakṣaḥ āśrayaṇīyaḥ iti āśaṅkya vidhi pakṣam sarmathya pratiṣedha pakṣaḥ api athavā punar astu pratiṣedhaḥ ityādinā bhāṣye samāśritaḥ

original: tatra pakṣe ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|nīgrahaṇaṃ jñāpanārtham "ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|nīdhātoḥ parasya niṣṭhātasyāpi natvaṃ bhavatīti' | na hyaprasaktasya pratiṣedhaḥ saṃbhavati ityāśayavānāha--ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍa|nīgrahaṇamiti ||jhrjñā.pa.ṭa nityaṃ samāse (sū.8-3-45)|| anuttarapadasthasyeti pratiṣedho jñāpakaḥ bhavati vākye vibhāṣeti |
analyzed: tatra pakṣe ḍhad dhaṭh ṭhaḍanī grahaṇam jñāpana artham ḍhad dhaṭh ṭhaḍanī dhātoḥ parasya niṣṭhā tasya api na tvam bhavati iti na hi aprasaktasya pratiṣedhaḥ saṃbhavati iti āśayavān āha ḍhad dhaṭh ṭhaḍanī grahaṇam iti nityam samāse sū 8345 an uttara pada sthasya iti pratiṣedhaḥ jñāpakaḥ bhavati vākye vibhāṣā iti

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "nityaṃ samāse'nuttarapadasthasya' iti sūtre anuttarapadasthasyetyetat paramasarpiḥ kuṇḍiḍḍatdh;kā ityādau visargasya ṣatvavāraṇārthamupādīyate | tatrānena ṣatvābhāve'pi "isusoḥ sārmathye' (sū.8-3-44) iti sūtreṇa ṣatvāpattiḥ |
analyzed: nanu nityam samāsena uttara pada sthasya iti sūtre anuttara pada sthasya iti etat parama sarpiḥ ityādau visargasya ṣatva vāraṇa artham upādīyate tatra anena ṣatva abhāve pi is usoḥ sārmathye sū 8344 iti sūtreṇa ṣa tva āpattiḥ

original: na ca tatra sūtre sārmathyapadena vyapekṣālakṣaṇaṃ sārmathyamevāśrīyate, paramasarpiḥ- kuṇḍiḍḍatdh;kā ityādeḥ samāsatvena ekārthībhāvalakṣaṇasārmathyasattve'pi vyapekṣālakṣaṇasārmathyābhāvāt na pūrvasūtraṃ pravartate iti vācyam | sārmathye iti sāmānyataḥ śravaṇena dvividhasyāpi sārmathyasya pūrvasūtre grahītuṃ śakyatvāt |
analyzed: na ca tatra sūtre sārmathya padena vyapekṣā lakṣaṇam sārmathyam eva āśrīyate parama sarpiḥ kuṇḍiḍḍatdhkā ityādeḥ samāsa tvena ekārthībhāva lakṣaṇa sārmathya sattve api vyapekṣā lakṣaṇa sārmathya abhāvāt na pūrva sūtram pravartate iti vācyam sārmathye iti sāmānyatas śravaṇena dvividhasya api sārmathyasya pūrva sūtre grahītum śakya tvāt

original: na ca tathāpi kṛtpratyayayo isūsorgrahaṇāt pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣyā sarpis ityasya isantatve'pi paramasarpis ityasya isantatvābhāvena paramasarpiḥ kuṇḍiḍḍatdh;kā ityatra pūrvasūtreṇa ṣatvaṃ na bhavatīti vācyam |
analyzed: na ca tathā api kṛt pratyayayoḥ is ūsoḥ grahaṇāt pratyaya grahaṇa paribhāṣyā sarpiḥ ityasya i s anta tve pi parama sarpiḥ ityasya i s anta tva abhāvena parama sarpiḥ iti atra pūrva sūtreṇa ṣatvam na bhavati iti vācyam

original: evaṃ sati "paramasarpiṣkaroti ' iti vākye'pi pūrvasūtreṇa ṣatvavikalpānupapatteḥ ityāśaṅkāṃ manasi nidhāyāha--anuttarapadasthasyeti pratiṣedha iti | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ--"nityaṃ samāsa' iti sūtre isusorityanuvartate | tatra yadi isusorviṣaye
analyzed: evam sati paramasarpiṣkaroti iti vākye api pūrva sūtreṇa ṣatva vikalpa anupapatteḥ iti āśaṅkām manasi nidhāya āha anuttara pada sthasya iti pratiṣedhaḥ iti ayam bhāvaḥ nityam samāsaḥ iti sūtre is usoḥ iti anuvartate tatra yadi is usoḥ viṣaye

original: pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣopatiṣṭheta tadā paramasarpiḥ kuṇḍiḍḍatdh;kā ityatra paramasarpiḥ śabdasya isantatvābhāvenaiva ṣatvaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti vimanuttarapadasthasyetyanena | kṛtaṃ ca tat isusorviṣaye pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣā na pravartata iti jñāpayati |
analyzed: pratyaya grahaṇa paribhāṣā upatiṣṭheta tadā parama sarpiḥ kuṇḍiḍḍatdhkāḥ iti atra parama sarpiḥ śabdasya is anta tva abhāvena eva ṣatvam na bhaviṣyati iti vim an uttara pada sthasya iti anena kṛtam ca tat is usoḥ viṣaye pratyaya grahaṇa paribhāṣā na pravartate iti jñāpayati

original: tena "isūsoḥ sārmathye' iti pūrvasūtre'pi tasyāḥ apravṛttyā paramasarpiṣkaroti iti vākyo'pi ṣatvaṃ vikalpena sidhyatīti | bhavati vākye vibhāṣā ityasya pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣāyāḥ apravṛttidvārā ityādiḥ | evaṃ ca paramasarpiḥ kuṇḍiḍḍatdh;kā ityādau ṣatvavāraṇāya pūrvasūtre vyapekṣālakṣaṇameva sārmathyamāśrayaṇīyamiti tattvām iti |
analyzed: tena sārmathye iti pūrva sūtre api tasyāḥ apravṛttyā paramasarpiṣkaroti iti ṣatvam vikalpena sidhyati iti bhavati vākye vibhāṣā iti asya pratyaya grahaṇa paribhāṣāyāḥ apravṛtti dvārā ityādiḥ evam ca parama sarpiḥ ityādau ṣatva vāraṇāya pūrva sūtre vyapekṣā lakṣaṇam eva sārmathyam āśrayaṇīyam iti tat tvām iti

original: jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ādeśapratyayayoḥ (sū.8-3-59)|| "sātpadādyoḥ' (sū.7-3-111) iti sātpratiṣedho jñāpayati bhavati pratyayāvayavasyāpi ṣatvamiti |
analyzed: ādeśa pratyayayoḥ sū8359 sāt pada ādyoḥ sū73111 iti sāt pratiṣedhaḥ jñāpayati bhavati pratyaya avayavasya api ṣa tvam iti

original: jhrvi.ṭa ṭhaādeśapratyayoḥ' iti sūtre ādeśaḥ pratyayaśca yaḥ sakāra iti sāmānādhikaraṇyenānvayapakṣe kariṣyati hariṣyatītyādau ṣatvaṃ na prāpnoti, sakārasya "sya' iti pratyayāvayavatve'pi pratyayatvābhāvādityāśaṅkya, bhāṣye jñāpakena pratyayāvayavasya sasya ṣatvaṃ sādhitam| tadāha--sātpadādyoriti |
analyzed: iti sūtre ādeśaḥ pratyayaḥ iti sūtre ādeśaḥ pratyayaḥ ca yaḥ sakāraḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena anvaya pakṣe kariṣyati hariṣyati ityādau ṣatvam na prāpnoti sakārasya syaḥ iti pratyaya avayava tve pi pratyaya tva abhāvāt iti āśaṅkya bhāṣye jñāpakena pratyaya avayavasya sasya ṣatvam sādhitam tat āha sāt pada ādyoḥ iti

original: "sātpadādyoḥ' iti sūtreṇa sādavayavasya padādeśca sakārasya ṣatvaṃ pratiṣidhyate | tatra sādavayavasya sakārasāya pratyayatvābhāvena "ādeśapratyayayayoḥ' iti ṣatvāprāptyā tanniṣedho vyarthaḥ san pratyayāvayavasyāpi "ādeśapratyayoḥ' ityanena ṣatvaṃ bhavatīta jñāpayati |
analyzed: sāt pada ādyoḥ iti sūtreṇa sāt avayavasya pada ādeḥ ca sakārasya ṣatvam pratiṣidhyate tatra sāt avayavasya pratyaya tva abhāvena ādeśa pratyayayoḥ iti ṣatva aprāptyā tad niṣedhaḥ vyarthaḥ san pratyaya avayavasya api ādeśa pratyayoḥ iti anena ṣatvam bhavati ita jñāpayati

original: tatasca sāditi pratyayāvayavasya sasyāpi ṣatvaprāptau tanniṣedhaphalakaṃ sādgrahaṇaṃ sārthakam | itthaṃ ca kariṣyatītyādāvapi ṣatvaṃ setsyatīti bhāvaḥ | tatraiva ādeśaḥ pratyayasya ca yaḥ sakāraḥ tasya ṣatvamiti vyākhyānāntaraṃ pradarśitam |
analyzed: tatas ca sāt iti pratyaya avayavasya sasya api ṣatva prāptau tad niṣedha phalakam sāt grahaṇam sārthakam ittham ca kariṣyati ityādau api ṣatvam setsyati iti bhāvaḥ tatra eva ādeśaḥ pratyayasya ca yaḥ sakāraḥ tasya ṣatvam iti vyākhyāna antaram pradarśitam

original: tatra pakṣe prathamāntādeśaśabdasya ṣaṣṭhyantapratyayaśabdasya ca samāso nopapadyata ityāśaṅkya jñāpanāt samarthanaṃ kṛtaṃ bhāṣye | tadāha-- jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ṭhaśāsivasighasīnāṃ ca' (sū.8-3-60) iti ghasigrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ nānāvibhaktyoreṣa samāsa iti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhaśāsivasidhasīnāṃ ca' iti sūtreṇa ghaseḥ sakārasya ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate |
analyzed: tatra pakṣe prathamā anta ādeśa śabdasya ṣaṣṭhī anta pratyaya śabdasya ca samāsaḥ na upapadyate iti āśaṅkya jñāpanāt samarthanam kṛtam bhāṣye tat āha jhrjñāpaṭa ṭha śāsi vasi ghasīnām ca sū iti ghasi grahaṇam jñāpakam nānā vibhaktyoḥ eṣa samāsaḥ iti ṭha śāsi vasi dhasīnām ca iti sūtreṇa ghaseḥ sakārasya ṣatvam vidhīyate

original: jakṣaturityudāharaṇam | yadi ādeśaḥ pratyayasya ca yaḥ sakāra iti na syāt tadā ādeśasya yaḥ saḥ tasya ṣatvamityarthaḥ syāt | tadā ghaseḥ adadhātvādeśatvena tadavayavasya sasya ādeśapratyayayorityanenaiva ṣatvasiddheḥ ghasigrahaṇamanarthakam |
analyzed: jakṣatuḥ iti udāharaṇam yadi ādeśaḥ pratyayasya ca yaḥ sakāraḥ iti na syāt tadā ādeśasya yaḥ saḥ tasya ṣatvam iti arthaḥ syāt tadā ghaseḥ adadhātu ādeśa tvena tad avayavasya sasya ādeśa pratyayayoḥ iti anena eva ṣatva siddheḥ ghasi grahaṇam anarthakam

original: kṛtaṃ ca tat ādeśaḥ pratyayāvayavaśca yaḥ sakārastasya ṣatvamiti sūtrārthaṃ jñāpayat nānāvibhattayoḥ ādeśapratyayayoḥ samāsaḥ na tu samānavibhaktikayoriti jñāpayati | tathā ca ghaseḥ sakārasya ādeśatvābhāvāt ṣatvāprāptai tatprāpti tatprāptiphalakaṃ śāsivasīti sūtre ghasigrahaṇaṃ sārthakamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kṛtam ca tat ādeśaḥ pratyaya avayavaḥ ca yaḥ sakāraḥ tasya ṣatvam iti sūtra artham jñāpayat nānā vibhattayoḥ ādeśa pratyayayoḥ samāsaḥ na tu samāna vibhaktikayoḥ iti jñāpayati tathā ca ghaseḥ sakārasya ādeśa tva abhāvāt tad prāpti tad prāpti phalakam sūtre ghasi grahaṇam sārthakam iti bhāvaḥ

original: atra pratyayāvayavaparapratyayaśabdena ādeśaśabdasya dvandvaḥ | tathā ca samānavibhaktikayoreva samāsaḥ | tathāpi ṣaṣṭhyantapratyayaśabdārthalākṣaṇikatvātpratyayaśabdasya vyadhikaraṇavibhaktikatvoktirityavadheyam |
analyzed: atra pratyaya avayava para pratyaya śabdena ādeśa śabdasya dvandvaḥ tathā ca samāna vibhaktikayoḥ eva samāsaḥ tathā api ṣaṣṭhī anta pratyaya śabda artha lākṣaṇika tvāt pratyaya śabdasya vyadhikaraṇa vibhaktika tva uktiḥ iti avadheyam

original: na ca ghasigrahaṇaṃ ādeśaśabdo nādeśāvayavapara ityatraiva jñāpakamastu noktavacane, athavā yathāśrutādeśaśabdapratyayabdayoḥ samānavibhaktikayoreva samāsa ityatraiva jñāpakamastu iti vācyam | samānavibhaktikayoḥ samāsasya jñāpakasādhyatvā bhāvāt | asati bādhake samānavibhaktikayoḥ samāsaḥ |
analyzed: na ca ghasi grahaṇam ādeśa śabdaḥ na ādeśa avayava paraḥ iti atra eva jñāpakam astu na ukta vacane athavā yathāśruta ādeśa śabda pratyaya bdayoḥ samāna vibhaktikayoḥ eva samāsaḥ iti atra eva jñāpakam astu iti vācyam samāna vibhaktikayoḥ samāsasya jñāpaka sādhya tvā bhāvāt asati bādhake samāna vibhaktikayoḥ samāsaḥ

original: prakṛte ca kariṣyatītyādau ṣatvānupapatteḥṣaṣṭhyantapratyayapadena samāsa iti niścite ādeśaśabdasyāpi tatsamānavibhaktikasyaiva samāso'stu iti śaṅkāyāmuktajñāpakena ādeśaśabdasya prathamāntatvamiti niścite nānāvibhaktyoreṣa samāsa ityarthataḥ parthavasānāditi | jhrjñā.paṭa na raparasṛpi (sū.8-3-110)||
analyzed: prakṛte ca kariṣyati ityādau ṣatva anupapatteḥ ṣaṣṭhī anta pratyaya padena samāsaḥ iti niścite ādeśa śabdasya api tad samāna vibhaktikasya eva samāsaḥ ustu iti śaṅkāyām ukta jñāpakena ādeśa śabdasya prathamā anta tvam iti niścite nānā vibhaktyoḥ eṣa samāsaḥ iti arthataḥ na ra para sṛpi sū83110

original: savanādiṣu aśvasanipāṭho jñāpayati aniṇantādapi ṣatvaṃ bhavatīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "na raparasṛpisṛjispṛśispṛhisavanādīnām' iti ṣatvaniṣedhasūtre savanādigaṇe aśvasaniśabdapāṭho vyarthaḥ | na ca tatpāṭhābhāve tadavayavasakārasya ṣatvāpattiriti vācyam |
analyzed: savana ādiṣu aśva sani pāṭhaḥ jñāpayati an iṇ antāt api ṣatvam bhavati iti nanu na ra para sṛpi sṛji spṛśi spṛhi savana ādīnām iti ṣatva niṣedha sūtre savana ādi gaṇe aśva sani śabda pāṭhaḥ vyarthaḥ na ca tad pāṭha abhāve tad avayava sakārasya ṣatva āpattiḥ iti vācyam

original: (sū.8-3-103) iti sūtreṇa hi ṣatvaprāptirvaktavyā | tatra iṇa ityasyānuvṛtteḥ iṇantapūrvapadātparasyaiva sasya ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate | aśvasaniśabde ca sakārasya iṇantapūrvapadātparatvābhāvena ṣatvāprāpterityāśaṅkaya jñāpakatayā tatpāṭhasārthakyāmāha--savanādiṣviti | tathā ca kvacidaniṇantātparasyāpi ṣatvaṃ bhavatīti jñāpyate |
analyzed: iti sūtreṇa hi ṣatva prāptiḥ vaktavyā tatra iṇaḥ iti asya anuvṛtteḥ iṇ anta pūrva padāt parasya eva sasya ṣatvam vidhīyate aśva sani śabde ca sakārasya iṇ anta pūrva padāt para tva abhāvena ṣatva aprāpteḥ iti āśaṅkaya jñāpaka tayā tad pāṭha sārthakyām āha savana ādiṣu iti tathā ca kvacid an iṇ antāt parasya api ṣatvam bhavati iti jñāpyate

original: tenāśvasaniśabde'pi ṣatvaprāptau tatpratiṣedārthaṃ savanādiṣu tasya pāṭhaḥ kriyate | jñāpanaprayojanaṃ tu jalāṣāhaṃ māṣa ityādau ṣatvasiddhiriti bhāṣye spaṣṭam | jhrjñā.pa.ṭa ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ (sū.8-4-41)|| "toḥ ṣi' (sū.8-4-43) iti pratiṣedho jñāpayati neha saṃkhyātānudeśo bhavatīti |
analyzed: tena aśva sani śabde api ṣatva prāptau tad pratiṣeda artham savana ādiṣu tasya pāṭhaḥ kriyate jñāpana prayojanam tu jalāṣāham māṣaḥ ityādau ṣatva siddhiḥ iti bhāṣye spaṣṭam ṣ ṭunā ṣ ṭuḥ sū toḥ ṣi sū iti pratiṣedhaḥ jñāpayati na iha saṃkhyāta anudeśaḥ bhavati iti

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' iti sūtre "yathāsaṃkhyamanudeśaḥ samānām' iti sūtreṇa yathāsaṃkhyāmanvayena sakārasya ṣakārasya ṣakāreṇa yoge ṣakāraḥ, tavargasya ṭavargeṇa yoge ṭavargaḥ ādeśa iti sūtrārthaḥ syāt | tatasca rāmaṣṭīkate peṣṭā ityādau ṣṭutvaṃ na syādityāśaṅkyāha--toḥ ṣi iti pratiṣedha iti |
